            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Companies</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Taxa média de juros das operações de crédito – pessoas jurídicas – total</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=20715" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>20715</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p>Average interest rates on new credit operations, weighted by amounts granted. The series cover both earmarked and non-earmarked credit.</p>
            <p>The rates are annual percentages observed monthly, as published by the BCB; they are not monthly interest rates and are not annualized again.</p>

        </div>

          <details id="info-fig3e" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Debt / 12-month income</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Endividamento das famílias com o Sistema Financeiro Nacional em relação à renda acumulada dos últimos doze meses</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=29037" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>29037</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Debt service / monthly income</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Comprometimento de renda das famílias com o serviço da dívida com o Sistema Financeiro Nacional – com ajuste sazonal</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=29034" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>29034</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p>Household indebtedness is the outstanding debt stock with the national financial system divided by household income accumulated over the previous twelve months.</p>
            <p>The debt-service burden relates expected interest and amortization payments to monthly household income, published as a seasonally adjusted three-month moving average.</p>
            <p>Both series are percentages, but their income denominators differ. They are plotted on one common scale without additional moving averages.</p>
            <p>The indicators cover households’ debt with the national financial system, not specifically BNDES loans.</p>

          <p id="subtitle-fig3c" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Loans with instalments over 90 days past due; % of each borrower group&#x27;s credit portfolio.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig3c" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig3c" aria-busy="true" aria-describedby="subtitle-fig3c"></div>

        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig3c" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
<p class="macro-series"><strong>Total</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Inadimplência da carteira de crédito – Total</em></span><br>All borrowers.<br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=21082" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>21082</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly. Unit: %.</p>
<p class="macro-series"><strong>Companies (PJ)</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Inadimplência da carteira de crédito – Pessoas jurídicas – Total</em></span><br>Non-financial corporations.<br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=21083" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>21083</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly. Unit: %.</p>
<p class="macro-series"><strong>Households (PF)</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Inadimplência da carteira de crédito – Pessoas físicas – Total</em></span><br>Households.<br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=21084" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>21084</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly. Unit: %.</p>
<p>The BCB measures the share of the credit portfolio with at least one instalment more than 90 days past due. Both earmarked and non-earmarked credit are included.</p>
<p>Total covers all borrowers. The BCB English catalogue identifies the PJ series as non-financial corporations and the PF series as households.</p>
<p>Each rate uses its own group’s credit portfolio as the denominator. These are percentages of loan balances, not percentages of people or companies.</p>
<p>Total is the aggregate published by the BCB; no simple average of the two borrower-group rates is calculated.</p>
<p>The native monthly percentages are shown directly, without annualization, a 12-month sum, smoothing, rebasing or interpolation. The available history starts in March 2011.</p>
<p>The official SGS API is checked through the dashboard’s monthly update cycle. Verified embedded observations remain available during temporary source outages.</p>

          <p id="subtitle-fig4a" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Seasonally adjusted monthly indices, 2022 = 100; services available from January 2011.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">

        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig4a" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Industrial production</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Produção industrial – indústria geral – com ajuste sazonal</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=28503" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>28503</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Retail trade</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Índice de volume de vendas no varejo – Brasil – com ajuste sazonal</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=28473" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>28473</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Services</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>PMS - Índice de volume de serviços com ajuste sazonal (2022=100)</em></span><br>IBGE SIDRA: <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/5906" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>5906</strong></a>, variable 7168; volume category 56726.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
<p>All three series are seasonally adjusted native indices with 2022 = 100. No additional rebasing, seasonal adjustment or smoothing is applied.</p>
<p>Industrial production and retail trade retain the existing BCB–SGS series 28503 and 28473. Services come directly from IBGE's Monthly Survey of Services (PMS), SIDRA table 5906, variable 7168, type of index 56726 (volume).</p>
<p>PMS covers the market non-financial services within the survey's scope, excluding health and education. It is not the services-sector value added from national accounts.</p>
<p>The PMS series begins in January 2011. Its native monthly dates are retained; no earlier services observations are created.</p>

    <div id="panel-fig4categories" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="XXV. Industrial production by economic category">

            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
              <p class="macro-series"><strong>Capital goods</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Bens de capital</em></span><br><a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/8887" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE / PIM-PF / SIDRA 8887</a>, variable 12607.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Intermediate goods</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Bens intermediários</em></span><br><a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/8887" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE / PIM-PF / SIDRA 8887</a>, variable 12607.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Consumer durables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Bens de consumo duráveis</em></span><br><a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/8887" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE / PIM-PF / SIDRA 8887</a>, variable 12607.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Semi/non-durables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Bens de consumo semiduráveis e não duráveis</em></span><br><a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/8887" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE / PIM-PF / SIDRA 8887</a>, variable 12607.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
              <p>These are native monthly seasonally adjusted volume indices on the published 2022 = 100 scale. No additional rebasing, seasonal adjustment, smoothing or interpolation is applied.</p>

<p>The four individual categories are capital goods, intermediate goods, consumer durables, and semi-durable/non-durable consumer goods.</p>

    <div id="panel-fig4capacity" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="XXVI. Manufacturing capacity utilisation">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-fig4capacity" class="macro-plot-title">XXVI. Manufacturing capacity utilisation</h3>
          <p class="macro-plot-subtitle">Share of manufacturing capacity in use; seasonally adjusted percentage, CNI via BCB–SGS.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig4capacity" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig4capacity" aria-busy="true"></div>
            <div id="presidents-fig4capacity" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
              <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div>
              <div id="president-items-fig4capacity" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig4capacity" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
              <p class="macro-series"><strong>Capacity utilisation</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Utilização da capacidade instalada da indústria de transformação</em></span><br>CNI, via BCB–SGS <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=28554" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">28554</a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
              <p>The series measures the percentage of installed manufacturing capacity in use. It is a capacity-utilisation level, not an index rebased to 100.</p>
<p>Monthly seasonally adjusted observations are supplied by CNI and distributed through BCB–SGS 28554. No additional adjustment, rebasing or smoothing is applied.</p>
<p>The SGS catalogue uses the generic unit label “Index”; the percentage interpretation was checked against the current CNI publication and historical workbook, including the July–August 2026 readings.</p>
<p>The currently published seasonally adjusted history is used throughout. Historical observations can be revised when the producer updates seasonal adjustment; older releases may show different historical values.</p>
<p>A higher percentage indicates greater utilisation of the surveyed manufacturing capacity. This is not productivity or the economy-wide output gap.</p>
<p>The source history starts in January 2003; earlier observations are not imputed.</p>
              <p>Official APIs are checked through the dashboard’s monthly update cycle. Verified embedded data remain available during temporary source outages; browser storage is optional.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p>
              <div id="latest-fig4capacity" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-fig4capacity" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <div class="macro-indicators">

          </div>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://www.portaldaindustria.com.br/estatisticas/indicadores-industriais/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">CNI — Industrial Indicators</a>, via <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=28554" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">BCB–SGS 28554</a>.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>
      <p id="status-fig4capacity" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

          <details id="info-fig4retail" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
              <p class="macro-series"><strong>Food retail</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Hipermercados, supermercados, produtos alimentícios, bebidas e fumo</em></span><br><a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/8882" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE / PMC / SIDRA 8882</a>, variable 7170.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Clothing</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Tecidos, vestuário e calçados</em></span><br><a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/8882" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE / PMC / SIDRA 8882</a>, variable 7170.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Furniture/appliances</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Móveis e eletrodomésticos</em></span><br><a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/8882" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE / PMC / SIDRA 8882</a>, variable 7170.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Vehicles</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Veículos, motocicletas, partes e peças</em></span><br><a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/8883" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE / PMC / SIDRA 8883</a>, variable 7170.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
              <p>These are native monthly seasonally adjusted volume indices on the published 2022 = 100 scale. No additional rebasing, seasonal adjustment, smoothing or interpolation is applied.</p>
<p>The published seasonally adjusted observations in 2022 need not average exactly 100. Their original values and scale are retained.</p>
<p>The lines compare each category’s trajectory over time. Index levels are not sector sizes, market shares or contributions to aggregate growth.</p>
<p>Each series retains its available history and latest source observation. Missing months are not filled or carried forward.</p>
<p>Food retail covers hypermarkets, supermarkets, food products, beverages and tobacco. Clothing covers textiles, apparel and footwear.</p>
<p>Vehicles, motorcycles, parts and accessories are taken from the expanded-retail survey (SIDRA 8883). They are compared as an individual segment, not included in the restricted-retail aggregate shown in the overview.</p>
<p>The four segments are a selection of PMC activities, not a complete decomposition of retail trade.</p>

              <p>These are native monthly seasonally adjusted volume indices on the published 2022 = 100 scale. No additional rebasing, seasonal adjustment, smoothing or interpolation is applied.</p>

            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Imports</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Importação de bens – Balanço de Pagamentos – mensal</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=22709" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>22709</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Trade balance</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Balança comercial – Balanço de Pagamentos – mensal – saldo</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=22707" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>22707</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p>Monthly flows of goods exports, imports and the trade balance, compiled under the BPM6 balance-of-payments framework.</p>
            <p>Each series is summed over twelve consecutive months, including the months before the display cutoff where needed, and converted from USD millions to USD billions. Values are nominal, not inflation-adjusted.</p>
            <p>A positive trade balance is a surplus; a negative balance is a deficit. Negative values are retained.</p>
            <p>BCB balance-of-payments trade data include coverage adjustments and may differ from customs-based figures published directly by the MDIC.</p>

  <section id="section-labor-market" class="macro-section" aria-labelledby="heading-labor-market">
    <details id="group-labor-market" class="macro-section-group" open>
      <summary class="macro-section-summary"><h2 id="heading-labor-market" class="macro-heading">Labor market</h2></summary>
      <div class="macro-section-body">
    <div id="panel-fig6c" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="XXXVI. Labor force, employment and unemployment">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-fig6c" class="macro-plot-title">XXXVI. Labor force, employment and unemployment</h3>
          <p class="macro-plot-subtitle">PNAD Continuous Survey, moving-quarter estimates; millions of people.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig6c" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig6c" aria-busy="true"></div>
            <div id="presidents-fig6c" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
              <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div>
              <div id="president-items-fig6c" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig6c" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Labor force — left axis</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>População na força de trabalho – PNADC</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=24378" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>24378</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Employed people — left axis</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Pessoas ocupadas – PNADC</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=24379" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>24379</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Unemployed people — right axis</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Pessoas desocupadas – PNADC</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=24380" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>24380</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p>The three series are estimates from the IBGE Continuous National Household Sample Survey (PNAD Continuous Survey), distributed through the SGS, for people aged 14 or older.</p>
            <p>Labor force and employed people use the left axis, fixed from 80 to 110 million people. Unemployed people use the right axis, fixed from 0 to 30 million people.</p>
            <p>The published SGS unit is thousands of people. Each value is divided by 1,000 to display millions of people; it is not divided by one million.</p>
            <p>Each date denotes the moving three-month reference period ending in that month. These are not counts for an isolated month. No additional moving average, seasonal adjustment or interpolation is applied.</p>
            <p>Labor force equals employed plus unemployed people, apart from rounding in the published series. The first observation is the moving quarter ending in March 2012; the x axis begins in January 2012.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p>
              <div id="latest-fig6c" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-fig6c" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <div class="macro-indicators"><p class="macro-key-title">Indicators</p><div id="keys-fig6c" class="macro-keys" aria-label="Indicator line styles"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://www.ibge.gov.br/estatisticas/sociais/trabalho/9173-pnad-continua.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE – PNAD Continuous Survey</a> – <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/localizarseries/localizarSeries.do?method=prepararTelaLocalizarSeries" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><em lang="pt-BR">Sistema Gerenciador de Séries Temporais (SGS)</em></a>, codes <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=24378" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>24378</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=24379" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>24379</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=24380" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>24380</strong></a>.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>

            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Overall</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Taxa de Informalidade (IBGE/Pnad Contínua)</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADCT_TXINFORMUF&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>PNADCT_TXINFORMUF</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: quarterly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>14–17 years</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Informalidade - 14 a 17 anos</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_1417&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_1417</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: quarterly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>18–24 years</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Informalidade - 18 a 24 anos</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_1824&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_1824</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: quarterly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>25–39 years</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Informalidade - 25 a 39 anos</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_2539&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_2539</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: quarterly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>40–59 years</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Informalidade - 40 a 59 anos</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_4059&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_4059</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: quarterly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>60 years and over</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Informalidade - mais de 60 anos</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_60M&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_60M</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: quarterly.</p>
            <p>Quarterly estimates for Brazil from the IBGE PNAD Continuous Survey, distributed through Ipeadata. Values are percentages as published, without additional scaling or smoothing.</p>
            <p>Informality rates are calculated among employed people aged 14 or older. Each subgroup rate uses the employed population within that subgroup as its denominator.</p>
            <p>Under the IBGE definition, informal employment includes private-sector employees and domestic workers without a signed work card, employers and own-account workers without a registered business (CNPJ), and contributing family workers.</p>
            <p>The Overall line uses the national informality rate and is identical in both panels. It is shown as a thicker black line.</p>
            <p>Each date denotes the reference calendar quarter, rather than a moving quarter. Lines connect available quarterly observations; no missing-quarter values are created.</p>
            <p>The final IBGE age category is 60 years and over. The Ipeadata series title says ‘mais de 60 anos’; the displayed category follows the IBGE age classification.</p>
            <p>Age categories: <a href="https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/agregados/4094/metadados" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE PNAD Continuous metadata</a>.</p>

            <p>Quarterly estimates for Brazil from the IBGE PNAD Continuous Survey, distributed through Ipeadata. Values are percentages as published, without additional scaling or smoothing.</p>

            <p>The Overall line uses the national informality rate and is identical in both panels. It is shown as a thicker black line.</p>

  <section id="section-inequality-poverty" class="macro-section" aria-labelledby="heading-inequality-poverty">
    <details id="group-inequality-poverty" class="macro-section-group" open>
      <summary class="macro-section-summary"><h2 id="heading-inequality-poverty" class="macro-heading">Inequality and poverty</h2></summary>
      <div class="macro-section-body">

    <div id="panel-fig7a" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="XLI. Income inequality: Gini index">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-fig7a" class="macro-plot-title">XLI. Income inequality: Gini index</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-fig7a" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Annual estimates; PNAD and PNAD Continuous series linked by Ipea.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig7a" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig7a" aria-describedby="subtitle-fig7a" aria-busy="true"></div>
            <div id="presidents-fig7a" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
              <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div>
              <div id="president-items-fig7a" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig7a" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Gini index</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Coeficiente de Gini da renda domiciliar per capita de todas as fontes</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADS_GINI&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>PNADS_GINI</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p>
            <p>Annual estimates for Brazil, based on per capita household income from all sources.</p>
            <p>Ipea links the former PNAD through 2011 to PNAD Continuous from 2012, using indicator-specific factors calculated in the 2012 overlap. The earlier observations are adjusted estimates.</p>
            <p>The original annual frequency is retained. Years without a survey, including 2000 and 2010, have no observations. Lines connect the available annual observations; no missing-year values are created.</p>
            <p>The source reports Gini on a 0–100 scale. Values are divided by 100 to display the conventional 0–1 scale; lower values indicate less inequality.</p>
            <p>Methodology: <a href="https://www.ipea.gov.br/portal/images/noticias/PDF/251125_nota_tecnica.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Souza and Hecksher (2025), Ipea</a>.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p>
              <div id="latest-fig7a" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-fig7a" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>

          <p class="macro-source">Source: Ipea / IBGE household surveys, via <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Ipeadata</a>: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADS_GINI&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">PNADS_GINI</a>.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>
      <p id="status-fig7a" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

    <div id="panel-fig7b" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="XLII. Income concentration: Palma ratio">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-fig7b" class="macro-plot-title">XLII. Income concentration: Palma ratio</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-fig7b" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Income share of the richest 10% divided by the income share of the poorest 40%.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig7b" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig7b" aria-describedby="subtitle-fig7b" aria-busy="true"></div>
            <div id="presidents-fig7b" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
              <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div>
              <div id="president-items-fig7b" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig7b" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Palma ratio</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Razão de Palma da renda domiciliar per capita de todas as fontes</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADS_PALMA&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>PNADS_PALMA</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p>
            <p>Annual estimates for Brazil, based on per capita household income from all sources.</p>
            <p>Ipea links the former PNAD through 2011 to PNAD Continuous from 2012, using indicator-specific factors calculated in the 2012 overlap. The earlier observations are adjusted estimates.</p>
            <p>The original annual frequency is retained. Years without a survey, including 2000 and 2010, have no observations. Lines connect the available annual observations; no missing-year values are created.</p>
            <p>The Palma ratio compares the two groups’ shares of total income. Higher values indicate greater income concentration.</p>
            <p>Methodology: <a href="https://www.ipea.gov.br/portal/images/noticias/PDF/251125_nota_tecnica.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Souza and Hecksher (2025), Ipea</a>.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p>
              <div id="latest-fig7b" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-fig7b" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>

          <p class="macro-source">Source: Ipea / IBGE household surveys, via <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Ipeadata</a>: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADS_PALMA&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">PNADS_PALMA</a>.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>
      <p id="status-fig7b" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Poverty</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Proporção de pessoas abaixo da linha de pobreza de PPC$8,30</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADS_PERCPOBRE830&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>PNADS_PERCPOBRE830</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Extreme poverty</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Proporção de pessoas abaixo da linha de pobreza de PPC$3,00</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADS_PERCPOBRE300&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>PNADS_PERCPOBRE300</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p>
            <p>Annual estimates for Brazil, based on per capita household income from all sources.</p>
            <p>Ipea links the former PNAD through 2011 to PNAD Continuous from 2012, using indicator-specific factors calculated in the 2012 overlap. The earlier observations are adjusted estimates.</p>
            <p>The original annual frequency is retained. Years without a survey, including 2000 and 2010, have no observations. Lines connect the available annual observations; no missing-year values are created.</p>
            <p>Poverty and extreme poverty are the percentages of the total population with per capita household income below the respective line.</p>
            <p>Both thresholds use 2021 purchasing power parities (PPP). In average 2024 prices, the thresholds correspond to BRL 738 and BRL 267 per person per month, respectively.</p>
            <p>The extreme-poverty population is included in the poverty population; the two series are not added together.</p>
            <p>Methodology: <a href="https://www.ipea.gov.br/portal/images/noticias/PDF/251125_nota_tecnica.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Souza and Hecksher (2025), Ipea</a>.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p>
              <div id="latest-fig7c" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-fig7c" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <div class="macro-indicators"><p class="macro-key-title">Indicators</p><div id="keys-fig7c" class="macro-keys" aria-label="Indicator line styles"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: Ipea / IBGE household surveys, via <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Ipeadata</a>: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADS_PERCPOBRE830&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">PNADS_PERCPOBRE830</a>, <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADS_PERCPOBRE300&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">PNADS_PERCPOBRE300</a>.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>
      <p id="status-fig7c" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

            <summary>About the data</summary>

            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Benefits (December)</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Programa Bolsa Família (PBF) - número de benefícios em dezembro</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;FAM_PBF&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>FAM_PBF</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p>
            <p>Bolsa Família is Brazil’s cash transfer programme for low-income families. The administrative series includes the Auxílio Brasil period and subsequent return to the Bolsa Família name.</p>
            <p>The source is MDS administrative records obtained from the federal Transparency Portal. Suspended benefits are excluded.</p>
            <p>Each annual observation is the number of benefits in December of the reference year. The count is divided by one million for display.</p>
            <p>The API labels annual observations by year. Each count is positioned in December, its reference month, to align with the government-period shading.</p>

    <div id="panel-fig7e" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="XLV. Bolsa Família transfers: nominal and real (BRL)">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-fig7e" class="macro-plot-title">XLV. Bolsa Família transfers: nominal and real (BRL)</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-fig7e" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Brazil’s cash transfer programme; monthly totals in BRL billions. Constant prices: <span data-price-base>latest common month</span> (IPCA).</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig7e" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig7e" aria-describedby="subtitle-fig7e" aria-busy="true"></div>
            <div id="presidents-fig7e" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
              <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div>
              <div id="president-items-fig7e" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig7e" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Current prices</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Programa Bolsa Família (PBF) - valor total mensal dos benefícios</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;VAL_PBF12&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>VAL_PBF12</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>IPCA-adjusted</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Programa Bolsa Família (PBF) - valor total mensal dos benefícios</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;VAL_PBF12&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>VAL_PBF12</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>IPCA price adjustment</strong><br>Monthly consumer price inflation, BCB–SGS <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=433" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>433</strong></a>.</p>
            <p>Bolsa Família is Brazil’s cash transfer programme for low-income families. The administrative series includes the Auxílio Brasil period and subsequent return to the Bolsa Família name.</p>
            <p>The source is MDS administrative records obtained from the federal Transparency Portal. Suspended benefits are excluded.</p>
            <p>Current-price transfers are the published monthly totals. The source unit is BRL thousands, divided by one million to display BRL billions.</p>
            <p>The constant-price series uses the compounded monthly IPCA changes from BCB–SGS 433. Each amount is multiplied by the ratio of the price index in the reference month to the index in the observation month.</p>
            <p>Price reference: <span data-price-base>latest common month</span>, the latest month jointly available in the transfers and IPCA series. The reference updates automatically when both sources contain a newer month.</p>
            <p>Only months with complete IPCA coverage are converted to constant prices. The original monthly frequency is retained.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p>
              <div id="latest-fig7e" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-fig7e" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <div class="macro-indicators"><p class="macro-key-title">Indicators</p><div id="keys-fig7e" class="macro-keys" aria-label="Indicator line styles"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: MDS / Transparency Portal, via <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Ipeadata</a>: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;VAL_PBF12&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">VAL_PBF12</a>. Price adjustment: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=433" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">BCB–SGS 433 (IPCA)</a>.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>
      <p id="status-fig7e" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

    <div id="panel-map-pbf" class="macro-panel macro-map-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-map-pbf">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-map-pbf" class="macro-plot-title">XLVI. Bolsa Família benefit payments by municipality</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-map-pbf" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Number of benefit payments recorded in January–December 2025; annual sum, not unique families.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-map-pbf" class="macro-map-chart" aria-labelledby="title-map-pbf" aria-describedby="subtitle-map-pbf" aria-busy="true"></div>
          </div>
          <p class="macro-map-coverage" data-map-coverage>Brazil · 5,570 / 5,570 municipalities with data</p>
          <p class="macro-map-detail" data-map-detail>Hover or tap a municipality to see its value.</p>
          <span class="macro-map-announcement" aria-live="polite" data-map-announcement></span>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-pbf" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
              <p>Number of payment records across all twelve 2025 payroll months (competência 202501–202512). Each record is one benefit payment. A recipient can appear in several months, and retroactive instalments can appear separately. This is not the number of unique families or people.</p><p>Source: CGU Transparency Portal, Novo Bolsa Família payment files. The year is defined by payroll month (competência), including retroactive instalments paid in those months, even where their benefit reference month is earlier. All three municipal maps use exactly the same payment records and January–December period.</p><p>Municipalities are matched using the official Treasury SIAFI-to-IBGE correspondence. These transaction-based CGU records differ from the MDS/Ipeadata count of families in a single month; the two definitions are not automatically substituted for each other.</p>
              <p>The colourbar is centred on the national median of available municipal indicator values. Each municipality contributes one observation; with an even number of observations, the median is the average of the two central values. The reference, minimum and maximum remain fixed when a state is selected.</p>
              <p>Green indicates lower values and red higher values. Log(1 + value) colour spacing is centred on the national municipal median.</p>
              <p>The maps use the same 5,570 municipal-level territories and simplified boundaries from IBGE’s 2022 reference. Source territories outside this boundary reference are counted separately; missing values are grey.</p>
              <p>Fixed full-year reference: 2025. The embedded snapshot was verified from all twelve official monthly payment files. The public CGU JSON API requires authentication; it is not queried with a secret key embedded in this page.</p>
              <p>This verified annual snapshot remains available independently of API access. It is never replaced by the December-only series.</p>
              <p><strong>Reference and verification</strong></p>
              <div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: January–December 2025. Embedded snapshot verified 2026-10-31.</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <label class="macro-map-control" for="state-map-pbf">State
            <select id="state-map-pbf" data-map-state aria-label="State shared by the municipal maps"><option value="BR">Brazil — all states</option></select>
          </label>
          <button id="download-map-pbf" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <p class="macro-map-reference">Green: lower values · red: higher values.<br>Centre: national municipal median.</p>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: CGU — <a href="https://portaldatransparencia.gov.br/download-de-dados/novo-bolsa-familia" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Transparency Portal, monthly 2025 payment files</a>.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>
      <p id="status-map-pbf" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

Each municipality contributes one observation; with an even number of observations, the median is the average of the two central values. The reference, minimum and maximum remain fixed when a state is selected.</p>

  <section id="section-education" class="macro-section" aria-labelledby="heading-education">
    <details id="group-education" class="macro-section-group" open>
      <summary class="macro-section-summary"><h2 id="heading-education" class="macro-heading">Education</h2></summary>
      <div class="macro-section-body">
    <div id="panel-fig8a" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="XLIX. Education completion by level">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-fig8a" class="macro-plot-title">XLIX. Education completion by level</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-fig8a" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Share completing each level among its reference-age cohort; observations through 2024.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig8a" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig8a" aria-describedby="subtitle-fig8a" aria-busy="true"></div>
            <div id="presidents-fig8a" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
              <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div>
              <div id="president-items-fig8a" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig8a" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info">
              <p class="macro-series"><strong>Primary</strong><br>Completion rate, primary education, both sexes (%)<br><a href="https://api.uis.unesco.org/api/public/data/indicators?indicator=CR.1&amp;geoUnit=BRA&amp;start=1995&amp;footnotes=true&amp;indicatorMetadata=true" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">UNESCO UIS</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Lower secondary</strong><br>Completion rate, lower secondary education, both sexes (%)<br><a href="https://api.uis.unesco.org/api/public/data/indicators?indicator=CR.2&amp;geoUnit=BRA&amp;start=1995&amp;footnotes=true&amp;indicatorMetadata=true" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">UNESCO UIS</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Upper secondary</strong><br>Completion rate, upper secondary education, both sexes (%)<br><a href="https://api.uis.unesco.org/api/public/data/indicators?indicator=CR.3&amp;geoUnit=BRA&amp;start=1995&amp;footnotes=true&amp;indicatorMetadata=true" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">UNESCO UIS</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p>For each level, UIS measures the share who completed its final grade among people aged three to five years above the intended age for that grade.</p><p>Primary, lower secondary and upper secondary therefore use different reference-age groups. The curves are not parts of one total and should not be added.</p><p>These are completion percentages, not annual graduation rates or average years of study. They are not directly comparable to the adult mean in the next chart.</p><p>Only published observations are shown. Lines connect available observations; missing-year values are not created.</p>
              <p>Automatic API checks use the same monthly cycle as the rest of the dashboard, beginning on the 20th in America/Fortaleza. New observations appear when the source releases them.</p>
              <p>Lines connect available observations. Missing calendar years are not filled with zero or fabricated. A verified snapshot remains available when a source API is temporarily unavailable.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p><div id="latest-fig8a" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-fig8a" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>

The age selection is 25+ even though the general source variable also supports younger age groups.</p><p>Source: IBGE Population Census, SIDRA table 10062, variable 13285, age category 58=108866.     <div id="panel-map-school-attendance-15-17" class="macro-panel macro-map-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-map-school-attendance-15-17">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-map-school-attendance-15-17" class="macro-plot-title">LII. Gross school attendance rate by municipality (ages 15–17)</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-map-school-attendance-15-17" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Residents aged 15–17 attending school at any education level; % of the same-age population, Census 2022.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-map-school-attendance-15-17" class="macro-map-chart" aria-labelledby="title-map-school-attendance-15-17" aria-describedby="subtitle-map-school-attendance-15-17" aria-busy="true"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-map-coverage" data-map-coverage>Brazil · 5,570 / 5,570 municipalities with data</p>
          <p class="macro-map-detail" data-map-detail>Hover or tap a municipality to see its value.</p>
          <span class="macro-map-announcement" aria-live="polite" data-map-announcement></span></div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-school-attendance-15-17" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info">
            <p>The gross attendance rate is the share of residents in the selected age group who attend school, irrespective of the level attended. The denominator is all residents aged 15–17.</p><p>It is not the upper-secondary net attendance rate and does not measure completion or attendance only at the expected education level.</p><p>The official published municipal percentages are retained. They are estimates from the Census 2022 sample; no municipal rates are averaged to calculate Brazil.</p><p>All sexes and all colour/race categories are selected through their published total categories.</p><p>Ten ordered national municipal decile classes use light lavender, blue and dark green, from lower to higher values. Each class contains approximately 10% of municipalities with data; equal values stay in the same class. Colours show relative rank groups, not equal numerical intervals or a judgement of good and bad outcomes.</p><p>Class limits are the nearest-rank 10th, 20th, …, 90th percentiles of municipal values across Brazil. Upper limits are included in the lower class; the first class also includes the minimum. Tied thresholds are merged if necessary. Legend labels are rounded for readability; classification uses full precision and the state filter retains the national class limits.</p>
            <p>Fixed reference: Census 2022. All selected total categories, formulas and source precision are checked against the official IBGE APIs.</p>
            <p>Colours show ten rank groups, each containing approximately 10% of municipalities with data. Equal values stay together. Numerical intervals differ between classes, and labels are rounded. The national class limits remain fixed when filtering a state.</p>
            <p>The maps use IBGE’s 5,570 municipal-level territories and simplified boundaries from 2022. Missing coverage is never filled with zero.</p>
            <p>Official APIs are checked on the dashboard’s monthly cycle. Verified snapshots and optional browser storage retain the last valid result during a temporary source failure.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations and API check</strong></p><div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: 2022. Embedded snapshot verified 2026-11-04.</div>
          </div></details>
          <label class="macro-map-control" for="state-map-school-attendance-15-17">State<select id="state-map-school-attendance-15-17" data-map-state aria-label="State shared by the municipal maps"><option value="BR">Brazil — all states</option></select></label>
          <button id="download-map-school-attendance-15-17" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <p class="macro-map-reference">Light lavender → blue → dark green: lower to higher.<br>Ten national municipal decile classes.<br>Class labels rounded.</p>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: IBGE — <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/10056" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">SIDRA 10056</a>; <a href="https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/agregados/10056/periodos/2022/variaveis/3795?localidades=N6%5Ball%5D&amp;classificacao=58%5B2792%5D%7C2%5B6794%5D%7C86%5B95251%5D" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">official API 1</a>.</p>
        </aside></div><p id="status-map-school-attendance-15-17" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

    <div id="panel-map-illiteracy-15-19" class="macro-panel macro-map-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-map-illiteracy-15-19">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-map-illiteracy-15-19" class="macro-plot-title">LIII. Illiteracy rate by municipality (ages 15–19)</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-map-illiteracy-15-19" class="macro-plot-subtitle">100 minus the published literacy rate for residents aged 15–19; % of the same-age population, Census 2022.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-map-illiteracy-15-19" class="macro-map-chart" aria-labelledby="title-map-illiteracy-15-19" aria-describedby="subtitle-map-illiteracy-15-19" aria-busy="true"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-map-coverage" data-map-coverage>Brazil · 5,570 / 5,570 municipalities with data</p>
          <p class="macro-map-detail" data-map-detail>Hover or tap a municipality to see its value.</p>
          <span class="macro-map-announcement" aria-live="polite" data-map-announcement></span></div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-illiteracy-15-19" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info">
            <p>SIDRA table 9543 publishes literacy, not illiteracy. This map is a derived indicator: illiteracy rate (%) = 100 − published literacy rate (%), using the 15–19 age category.</p><p>Literacy concerns the ability to read and write at least a simple note in a language the person knows. The denominator is all residents aged 15–19.</p><p>The derivation retains the source rate’s two decimal places. It is not calculated from rounded person counts, and the national reference is derived from the separately published Brazil rate.</p><p>This indicator comes from the Census 2022 full-count literacy results. All sexes and all colour/race categories are selected through their published total categories.</p><p>This map uses ten national classes tailored to the long right tail: seven nearest-rank quantile bands calculated only among municipalities with illiteracy rates up to and including 5%; then three bands above 5% to 10%, above 10% to 20%, and above 20%.</p><p>These classes have unequal numbers of municipalities and are not deciles. The seven lower bands preserve geographical variation in the main distribution, while the three upper bands distinguish unusually high rates.</p><p>All original percentages are retained, including zero and the maximum. No rate is capped, excluded or replaced. Class limits use full precision; labels are rounded for readability. Upper limits are included in the lower class, equal values stay together, and empty bands are merged if necessary.</p><p>All class limits use municipalities across Brazil. Filtering a state preserves that national reference.</p>
            <p>Fixed reference: Census 2022. All selected total categories, formulas and source precision are checked against the official IBGE APIs.</p>
            <p>Colours show seven quantile bands among municipalities with rates up to 5%, followed by separate bands above 5% to 10%, above 10% to 20%, and above 20%. The classes have unequal counts. Original percentages are retained, and filtering a state preserves the national class limits.</p>
            <p>The maps use IBGE’s 5,570 municipal-level territories and simplified boundaries from 2022. Missing coverage is never filled with zero.</p>
            <p>Official APIs are checked on the dashboard’s monthly cycle. Verified snapshots and optional browser storage retain the last valid result during a temporary source failure.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations and API check</strong></p><div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: 2022. Embedded snapshot verified 2026-11-04.</div>
          </div></details>
          <label class="macro-map-control" for="state-map-illiteracy-15-19">State<select id="state-map-illiteracy-15-19" data-map-state aria-label="State shared by the municipal maps"><option value="BR">Brazil — all states</option></select></label>
          <button id="download-map-illiteracy-15-19" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <p class="macro-map-reference">Light lavender → blue → dark green: lower to higher.<br>7 national quantile bands up to 5%; then >5–10%, >10–20%, >20%.<br>Class labels rounded.</p>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: IBGE — <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/9543" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">SIDRA 9543</a>; <a href="https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/agregados/9543/periodos/2022/variaveis/2513?localidades=N6%5Ball%5D&amp;classificacao=2%5B6794%5D%7C86%5B95251%5D%7C287%5B93086%5D" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">official API 1</a>.</p>
        </aside></div><p id="status-map-illiteracy-15-19" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig8c" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info">
              <p class="macro-series"><strong>Below completed fundamental</strong><br>Fundamental incompleto<br><a href="https://www.gov.br/trabalho-e-emprego/pt-br/acesso-a-informacao/acoes-e-programas/programas-projetos-acoes-obras-e-atividades/estatisticas-trabalho/painel-de-indicadores-da-rede-de-observatorios-do-trabalho" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">MTE / RAIS</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Fundamental completed</strong><br>Fundamental completo<br><a href="https://www.gov.br/trabalho-e-emprego/pt-br/acesso-a-informacao/acoes-e-programas/programas-projetos-acoes-obras-e-atividades/estatisticas-trabalho/painel-de-indicadores-da-rede-de-observatorios-do-trabalho" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">MTE / RAIS</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Secondary completed</strong><br>Médio completo<br><a href="https://www.gov.br/trabalho-e-emprego/pt-br/acesso-a-informacao/acoes-e-programas/programas-projetos-acoes-obras-e-atividades/estatisticas-trabalho/painel-de-indicadores-da-rede-de-observatorios-do-trabalho" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">MTE / RAIS</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Tertiary completed or higher</strong><br>Superior completo ou mais<br><a href="https://www.gov.br/trabalho-e-emprego/pt-br/acesso-a-informacao/acoes-e-programas/programas-projetos-acoes-obras-e-atividades/estatisticas-trabalho/painel-de-indicadores-da-rede-de-observatorios-do-trabalho" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">MTE / RAIS</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p>RAIS counts formal employment links active on 31 December. A person holding two active formal jobs may contribute two links.</p><p>Each curve is a schooling group’s share of the national job-link total. The four mutually exclusive groups sum to 100%; they describe jobs, not the whole adult population.</p><p>Brazilian fundamental education covers primary and lower secondary schooling. The four labels are the broad groups supplied by the dashboard. Reconciliation with the official 2025 RAIS presentation supports interpreting incomplete study at the next level within the preceding completed-level group.</p><p>No schooling groups are converted to years of study here. RAIS/eSocial reporting changes may affect comparisons over time.</p>
              <p>Automatic API checks use the same monthly cycle as the rest of the dashboard, beginning on the 20th in America/Fortaleza. New observations appear when the source releases them.</p>
              <p>Lines connect available observations. Missing calendar years are not filled with zero or fabricated. A verified snapshot remains available when a source API is temporarily unavailable.</p>

    <div id="panel-fig9a" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="LV. Life expectancy at birth">

          <details id="info-fig9a" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info">
              <p class="macro-series"><strong>Total</strong><br>Life expectancy at birth, total (years)<br><a href="https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SP.DYN.LE00.IN?locations=BR" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">World Bank WDI</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Men</strong><br>Life expectancy at birth, male (years)<br><a href="https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SP.DYN.LE00.MA.IN?locations=BR" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">World Bank WDI</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Women</strong><br>Life expectancy at birth, female (years)<br><a href="https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SP.DYN.LE00.FE.IN?locations=BR" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">World Bank WDI</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p>Life expectancy at birth is the number of years a newborn would live if the mortality rates prevailing at birth remained constant throughout life.</p><p>These internationally harmonised UN population estimates are distributed by the World Bank World Development Indicators API. They are not the IBGE life-table series; values and revisions can differ.</p><p>Reference years follow the source observations; database update dates are not observation years. Total is the source-published series, not an average calculated from the male and female curves.</p>
              <p>Automatic API checks use the same monthly cycle as the rest of the dashboard, beginning on the 20th in America/Fortaleza. New observations appear when the source releases them.</p>

              <div id="president-items-fig9b" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig9b" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info">
              <p class="macro-series"><strong>Under age 5</strong><br>Mortality rate, under-5 (per 1,000 live births)<br><a href="https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SH.DYN.MORT?locations=BR" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">World Bank WDI</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Under age 1</strong><br>Mortality rate, infant (per 1,000 live births)<br><a href="https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SP.DYN.IMRT.IN?locations=BR" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">World Bank WDI</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>First 28 days</strong><br>Mortality rate, neonatal (per 1,000 live births)<br><a href="https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SH.DYN.NMRT?locations=BR" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">World Bank WDI</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p>Published estimates from the UN Inter-agency Group for Child Mortality Estimation, distributed through the World Bank WDI API.</p><p>Infant mortality covers deaths before age 1; neonatal mortality covers deaths during the first 28 completed days; under-five mortality is the probability of dying before age 5, expressed per 1,000 live births.</p><p>The age bands overlap. Neonatal deaths are included in infant deaths, and infant deaths are included in under-five deaths. The three curves must not be added.</p><p>Only source-published annual estimates are used. Missing or unreleased years are not extrapolated.</p>
              <p>Automatic API checks use the same monthly cycle as the rest of the dashboard, beginning on the 20th in America/Fortaleza. New observations appear when the source releases them.</p>
              <p>Lines connect available observations. Missing calendar years are not filled with zero or fabricated. A verified snapshot remains available when a source API is temporarily unavailable.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p><div id="latest-fig9b" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-fig9b" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>

          <p class="macro-source">Source: UN Inter-agency Group for Child Mortality Estimation (UN IGME); via <a href="https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SH.DYN.MORT?locations=BR" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">World Bank WDI</a>.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>
      <p id="status-fig9b" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>

Each API refresh retrieves the full history from one revision; older WDI estimates are not spliced into either curve.</p>

              <p class="macro-series"><strong>Physicians</strong><br>Physicians<br><a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/ExibeSerieR.aspx?module=S&amp;serid=2096726991" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Ipeadata</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Nurses</strong><br>Nurses<br><a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/ExibeSerieR.aspx?module=S&amp;serid=2096726992" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Ipeadata</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Dentists</strong><br>Dentists per 10,000 residents<br><a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/ExibeSerieR.aspx?module=S&amp;serid=2096726994" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Ipeadata</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p>CNES is Brazil’s national health-facility register. These densities concern professionals recorded at health facilities, rather than everyone licensed by professional councils.</p><p>All three series are annual averages of monthly professional densities per 10,000 residents, using IBGE population projections, 2024 edition.</p><p>The physician series uses the CNES individuals-by-CBO-2002 selection and is not restricted to professionals working exclusively in SUS, Brazil’s public health system.</p><p>Registration does not measure full-time equivalent staffing, geographic access or quality of care.</p>
