  <section id="section-population" class="macro-section" aria-labelledby="heading-population">
    <details id="group-population" class="macro-section-group" open>
      <summary class="macro-section-summary"><h2 id="heading-population" class="macro-heading">Population</h2></summary>
      <div class="macro-section-body">
    <div id="panel-map-population-ln" class="macro-panel macro-map-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-map-population-ln">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-map-population-ln" class="macro-plot-title">LIX. Resident population by municipality (natural logarithm)</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-map-population-ln" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Natural logarithm of resident population; all nationalities, sexes and ages, Census 2022. Hover shows the original person count.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-map-population-ln" class="macro-map-chart" aria-labelledby="title-map-population-ln" aria-describedby="subtitle-map-population-ln" aria-busy="true"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-map-coverage" data-map-coverage>Brazil · 5,570 / 5,570 municipalities with data</p>
          <p class="macro-map-detail" data-map-detail>Hover or tap a municipality to see its value.</p>
          <span class="macro-map-announcement" aria-live="polite" data-map-announcement></span></div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-population-ln" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info">
            <p>The selected nationality category is Total, combining all nationalities. Sex and age are also Total.</p><p>The mapped value is ln(population), using the natural logarithm of the published person count. It is not ln(1 + population).</p><p>The colourbar shows logarithmic values; hover/tap also reports the original count in people. All municipal total counts are positive.</p><p>Ten ordered national municipal decile classes use light lavender, blue and dark green, from lower to higher values. Each class contains approximately 10% of municipalities with data; equal values stay in the same class. Colours show relative rank groups, not equal numerical intervals or a judgement of good and bad outcomes.</p><p>Class limits are the nearest-rank 10th, 20th, …, 90th percentiles of municipal values across Brazil. Upper limits are included in the lower class; the first class also includes the minimum. Tied thresholds are merged if necessary. Legend labels are rounded for readability; classification uses full precision and the state filter retains the national class limits.</p><p>The logarithm preserves order, so decile membership is the same as for the original population counts. Class boundaries remain in ln(people), and hover/tap retains the original count.</p>
            <p>Fixed reference: Census 2022. All selected total categories, formulas and source precision are checked against the official IBGE APIs.</p>
            <p>Colours show ten rank groups, each containing approximately 10% of municipalities with data. Equal values stay together. Numerical intervals differ between classes, and labels are rounded. The national class limits remain fixed when filtering a state.</p>
            <p>The maps use IBGE’s 5,570 municipal-level territories and simplified boundaries from 2022. Missing coverage is never filled with zero.</p>
            <p>Official APIs are checked on the dashboard’s monthly cycle. Verified snapshots and optional browser storage retain the last valid result during a temporary source failure.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations and API check</strong></p><div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: 2022. Embedded snapshot verified 2026-11-04.</div>
          </div></details>
          <label class="macro-map-control" for="state-map-population-ln">State<select id="state-map-population-ln" data-map-state aria-label="State shared by the municipal maps"><option value="BR">Brazil — all states</option></select></label>
          <button id="download-map-population-ln" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <p class="macro-map-reference">Light lavender → blue → dark green: lower to higher.<br>Ten national municipal decile classes.<br>Class labels rounded.</p>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: IBGE — <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/10157" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">SIDRA 10157</a>; <a href="https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/agregados/10157/periodos/2022/variaveis/93?localidades=N6%5Ball%5D&amp;classificacao=302%5B77794%5D%7C2%5B6794%5D%7C58%5B95253%5D" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">official API 1</a>.</p>
        </aside></div><p id="status-map-population-ln" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

    <div id="panel-fig10pyramid" class="macro-panel macro-pyramid-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-fig10pyramid">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-fig10pyramid" class="macro-plot-title">LX. Population pyramid by sex and age — Brazil, Census 2022</h3>
          <p class="macro-plot-subtitle">Men on the left, women on the right; each age-sex group as a share of Brazil’s total population.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas">
          <div id="chart-fig10pyramid" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig10pyramid" aria-busy="true"></div>
        </div></div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig10pyramid" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info">
            <p>The national population is divided into 21 non-overlapping age groups: twenty five-year groups from 0–4 to 95–99, followed by the open group 100 years or older.</p><p>Both sides use the same denominator: Brazil’s population of both sexes and all ages, 203,080,756 residents in the verified Census 2022 snapshot. The shares are not normalised separately within each sex.</p><p>The two sides add to 100% across all age groups. The verified totals are 98,532,431 men (48.52%) and 104,548,325 women (51.48%).</p><p>Men appear on the left in black and women on the right in grey. The horizontal scale is symmetric, and labels show positive percentages on both sides. Negative drawing coordinates do not represent negative residents.</p><p>Hover or tap identifies sex, age group, the original positive resident count and its percentage of the common national denominator.</p><p>The youngest group is at the bottom and residents aged 100 or older are at the top. No smoothing, interpolation, seasonal adjustment or annual projection is applied.</p><p>The official IBGE API is checked for revisions to the fixed 2022 dataset. Verified data remain available if the source is temporarily unavailable.</p><p><strong>Reference dataset</strong></p>
            <div id="latest-fig10pyramid" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">Census 2022 · Brazil</div>
          </div></details>
          <button id="download-fig10pyramid" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <div class="macro-indicators"><p class="macro-key-title">Sex</p>
            <div id="keys-fig10pyramid" class="macro-keys" aria-label="Sex and side of the population pyramid">
              <span class="macro-key"><span class="macro-key-sample" style="height:8px;border:none;background:#111111"></span><span class="macro-key-label">Men — left; share of total population</span></span>
              <span class="macro-key"><span class="macro-key-sample" style="height:8px;border:none;background:#808080"></span><span class="macro-key-label">Women — right; share of total population</span></span>
            </div></div>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/9514" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE–SIDRA 9514</a>, Census 2022; <a href="https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/agregados/9514/periodos/2022/variaveis/93?localidades=N1%5B1%5D&amp;classificacao=2%5B6794%2C4%2C5%5D%7C287%5B100362%2C93070%2C93084%2C93085%2C93086%2C93087%2C93088%2C93089%2C93090%2C93091%2C93092%2C93093%2C93094%2C93095%2C93096%2C93097%2C93098%2C49108%2C49109%2C60040%2C60041%2C6653%5D%7C286%5B113635%5D" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">official API</a>.</p>
        </aside></div><p id="status-fig10pyramid" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

    <div id="panel-map-household-size" class="macro-panel macro-map-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-map-household-size">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-map-household-size" class="macro-plot-title">LXI. Mean residents per private household by municipality</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-map-household-size" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Average number of residents per private household; all household-reference-person ages, sexes and colours or races, Census 2022.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-map-household-size" class="macro-map-chart" aria-labelledby="title-map-household-size" aria-describedby="subtitle-map-household-size" aria-busy="true"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-map-coverage" data-map-coverage>Brazil · 5,570 / 5,570 municipalities with data</p>
          <p class="macro-map-detail" data-map-detail>Hover or tap a municipality to see its value.</p>
          <span class="macro-map-announcement" aria-live="polite" data-map-announcement></span></div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-household-size" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info">
            <p>The age, sex and colour-or-race filters refer to the household reference person. All are set to Total.</p><p>The variable is the published mean number of people per private household, not a percentage or a municipal population count.</p><p>The national value is the published IBGE result. The unweighted mean of municipal averages is not used as the national figure.</p>
            <p>Fixed reference: Census 2022. All selected total categories, formulas and source precision are checked against the official IBGE APIs.</p>
            <p>Colours show this indicator’s magnitude. The national municipal median gives one observation to each municipality with data; it is not a population-weighted national average. State filters retain the national colour reference.</p>
            <p>The maps use IBGE’s 5,570 municipal-level territories and simplified boundaries from 2022. Missing coverage is never filled with zero.</p>
            <p>Official APIs are checked on the dashboard’s monthly cycle. Verified snapshots and optional browser storage retain the last valid result during a temporary source failure.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations and API check</strong></p><div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: 2022. Embedded snapshot verified 2026-11-04.</div>
          </div></details>
          <label class="macro-map-control" for="state-map-household-size">State<select id="state-map-household-size" data-map-state aria-label="State shared by the municipal maps"><option value="BR">Brazil — all states</option></select></label>

          <p class="macro-source">Source: IBGE — <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/9877" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">SIDRA 9877</a>; <a href="https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/agregados/9877/periodos/2022/variaveis/9325?localidades=N6%5Ball%5D&amp;classificacao=11561%5B100679%5D%7C12237%5B104570%5D%7C11562%5B72593%5D" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">official API 1</a>.</p>

    <div id="panel-map-older65" class="macro-panel macro-map-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-map-older65">

          <h3 id="title-map-older65" class="macro-plot-title">LXII. Population aged 65+ by municipality</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-map-older65" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Residents aged 65+ as a share of the municipal population; %, Census 2022.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-map-older65" class="macro-map-chart" aria-labelledby="title-map-older65" aria-describedby="subtitle-map-older65" aria-busy="true"></div>
          </div>
          <p class="macro-map-coverage" data-map-coverage>Brazil · 5,570 / 5,570 municipalities with data</p>
          <p class="macro-map-detail" data-map-detail>Hover or tap a municipality to see its value.</p>

        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-older65" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
              <p>Residents aged 65 years or older.</p><p>All residents.</p><p>Calculated as 100 × numerator / denominator, using unrounded official counts.</p><p>Age in completed years at the Census 2022 reference date. Covers the full resident population, including collective households.</p><p>Fixed reference: Census 2022; the map must not automatically advance to a later census or population estimate.</p><p>Colours indicate the magnitude of this indicator, not a ranking of municipal performance or welfare.</p>
              <p>The colourbar is centred on the national median of available municipal indicator values. Each municipality contributes one observation; with an even number of observations, the median is the average of the two central values. The reference, minimum and maximum remain fixed when a state is selected.</p>
              <p>Linear colour spacing on either side of the national municipal median; green indicates lower values and red higher values.</p>
              <p>The maps use the same 5,570 municipal-level territories and simplified boundaries from IBGE’s 2022 reference. Source territories outside this boundary reference are counted separately; missing values are grey.</p>
              <p>Automatic source checks follow the dashboard’s monthly cycle beginning on the 20th, in America/Fortaleza, when the page is visited or remains open and visible. Revisions to the 2022 observations appear after a successful source check; the Census reference remains fixed at 2022.</p>
              <p>Verified snapshots and optional browser storage keep the last valid published dataset available during a temporary API failure. The shared scheduler retries failed checks.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations and API check</strong></p>
              <div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: 2022. Embedded snapshot verified 2026-10-31.</div>
            </div>

It is a demographic ratio, not a percentage of the whole population.</p><p>Fixed reference: Census 2022; the map must not automatically advance to a later census or population estimate.</p><p>Colours indicate the magnitude of this indicator, not a ranking of municipal performance or welfare.</p>

    <div id="panel-map-ever-lived-outside" class="macro-panel macro-map-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-map-ever-lived-outside">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-map-ever-lived-outside" class="macro-plot-title">LXV. Residents who have ever lived outside the municipality (%)</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-map-ever-lived-outside" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Residents who have ever lived elsewhere / all municipal residents × 100; all ages and residence durations, Census 2022.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-map-ever-lived-outside" class="macro-map-chart" aria-labelledby="title-map-ever-lived-outside" aria-describedby="subtitle-map-ever-lived-outside" aria-busy="true"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-map-coverage" data-map-coverage>Brazil · 5,570 / 5,570 municipalities with data</p>
          <p class="macro-map-detail" data-map-detail>Hover or tap a municipality to see its value.</p>
          <span class="macro-map-announcement" aria-live="polite" data-map-announcement></span></div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-ever-lived-outside" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info">
            <p>Derived as 100 × people who have ever lived outside the municipality (SIDRA 3182, variable 1458, all durations) / resident population (SIDRA 10157, variable 93).</p><p>All sexes and ages are selected. This includes return migrants and moves from other municipalities or countries.</p><p>No minimum time spent outside is imposed. Duration in table 3182 refers to uninterrupted residence in the current municipality.</p><p>The requested original percentage distributes the people who have ever lived outside; its Total is 100%. The approved population-share calculation uses the published person counts instead.</p><p>Both counts come from the same Census migration publication. They are rounded sample estimates; resulting proportions inherit this rounding.</p>
            <p>Fixed reference: Census 2022. All selected total categories, formulas and source precision are checked against the official IBGE APIs.</p>
            <p>Colours show this indicator’s magnitude. The national municipal median gives one observation to each municipality with data; it is not a population-weighted national average. State filters retain the national colour reference.</p>
            <p>The maps use IBGE’s 5,570 municipal-level territories and simplified boundaries from 2022. Missing coverage is never filled with zero.</p>
            <p>Official APIs are checked on the dashboard’s monthly cycle. Verified snapshots and optional browser storage retain the last valid result during a temporary source failure.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations and API check</strong></p><div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: 2022. Embedded snapshot verified 2026-11-04.</div>
          </div></details>
          <label class="macro-map-control" for="state-map-ever-lived-outside">State<select id="state-map-ever-lived-outside" data-map-state aria-label="State shared by the municipal maps"><option value="BR">Brazil — all states</option></select></label>
          <button id="download-map-ever-lived-outside" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <p class="macro-map-reference">Red: lower values · green: higher values.<br>Centre: national municipal median.</p>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: IBGE — <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/3182" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">SIDRA 3182</a>, <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/10157" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">SIDRA 10157</a>; <a href="https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/agregados/3182/periodos/2022/variaveis/1458?localidades=N6%5Ball%5D&amp;classificacao=305%5B0%5D%7C2%5B0%5D%7C58%5B0%5D" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">official API 1</a>, <a href="https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/agregados/10157/periodos/2022/variaveis/93?localidades=N6%5Ball%5D&amp;classificacao=302%5B77794%5D%7C2%5B6794%5D%7C58%5B95253%5D" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">official API 2</a>.</p>
        </aside></div><p id="status-map-ever-lived-outside" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>

    <div id="panel-map-five-year-migration" class="macro-panel macro-map-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-map-five-year-migration">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-map-five-year-migration" class="macro-plot-title">LXVI. Residents aged 5+ who lived elsewhere five years earlier (%)</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-map-five-year-migration" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Residents aged 5+ living elsewhere in 2017 / all municipal residents aged 5+ × 100; fixed-date migration, Census 2022.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-map-five-year-migration" class="macro-map-chart" aria-labelledby="title-map-five-year-migration" aria-describedby="subtitle-map-five-year-migration" aria-busy="true"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-map-coverage" data-map-coverage>Brazil · 5,570 / 5,570 municipalities with data</p>
          <p class="macro-map-detail" data-map-detail>Hover or tap a municipality to see its value.</p>
          <span class="macro-map-announcement" aria-live="polite" data-map-announcement></span></div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-five-year-migration" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info">
            <p>Derived as 100 × people aged 5+ who did not live in the current municipality five years before the Census reference (SIDRA 10160, variable 13435) / municipal residents aged 5+.</p><p>The denominator is Total minus ages 0–4 in SIDRA 10157, variable 93, using the same Census sample publication.</p><p>The comparison is residence in 2017 and 2022, including previous residence in another municipality or abroad. It does not count every move made during the interval.</p><p>The original percentage variable describes the age/sex distribution of these migrants and equals 100% for Total. The approved map uses the derived population share.</p><p>Published person estimates are rounded; small national-versus-municipal sum differences are retained.</p>
            <p>Fixed reference: Census 2022. All selected total categories, formulas and source precision are checked against the official IBGE APIs.</p>
            <p>Colours show this indicator’s magnitude. The national municipal median gives one observation to each municipality with data; it is not a population-weighted national average. State filters retain the national colour reference.</p>
            <p>The maps use IBGE’s 5,570 municipal-level territories and simplified boundaries from 2022. Missing coverage is never filled with zero.</p>
            <p>Official APIs are checked on the dashboard’s monthly cycle. Verified snapshots and optional browser storage retain the last valid result during a temporary source failure.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations and API check</strong></p><div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: 2022. Embedded snapshot verified 2026-11-04.</div>
          </div></details>
          <label class="macro-map-control" for="state-map-five-year-migration">State<select id="state-map-five-year-migration" data-map-state aria-label="State shared by the municipal maps"><option value="BR">Brazil — all states</option></select></label>
          <button id="download-map-five-year-migration" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <p class="macro-map-reference">Red: lower values · green: higher values.<br>Centre: national municipal median.</p>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: IBGE — <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/10160" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">SIDRA 10160</a>, <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/10157" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">SIDRA 10157</a>; <a href="https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/agregados/10160/periodos/2022/variaveis/13435?localidades=N6%5Ball%5D&amp;classificacao=2%5B6794%5D%7C58%5B95253%5D" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">official API 1</a>, <a href="https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/agregados/10157/periodos/2022/variaveis/93?localidades=N6%5Ball%5D&amp;classificacao=302%5B77794%5D%7C2%5B6794%5D%7C58%5B95253%5D" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">official API 2</a>, <a href="https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/agregados/10157/periodos/2022/variaveis/93?localidades=N6%5Ball%5D&amp;classificacao=302%5B77794%5D%7C2%5B6794%5D%7C58%5B1140%5D" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">official API 3</a>.</p>
        </aside></div><p id="status-map-five-year-migration" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

    <div id="panel-map-foreign-population-percent" class="macro-panel macro-map-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-map-foreign-population-percent">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-map-foreign-population-percent" class="macro-plot-title">LXVII. Foreign-national share of residents by municipality (%)</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-map-foreign-population-percent" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Foreign nationals as a share of all municipal residents; all sexes and ages, Census 2022.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-map-foreign-population-percent" class="macro-map-chart" aria-labelledby="title-map-foreign-population-percent" aria-describedby="subtitle-map-foreign-population-percent" aria-busy="true"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-map-coverage" data-map-coverage>Brazil · 5,570 / 5,570 municipalities with data</p>
          <p class="macro-map-detail" data-map-detail>Hover or tap a municipality to see its value.</p>
          <span class="macro-map-announcement" aria-live="polite" data-map-announcement></span></div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-foreign-population-percent" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info">
            <p>The nationality category is Estrangeira (foreign), SIDRA category 6833. Sex and age are both Total.</p><p>The denominator is the full resident population of each municipality, across all nationalities.</p><p>Nationality differs from place of birth. Brazilian-born or foreign-born Brazilian nationals, including naturalised Brazilians, are not counted as foreign nationals.</p><p>The published percentage is retained at five-decimal API precision. Hover values show five decimals; fixed class limits use two decimals.</p><p>Observed zero percentages retain medium-grey fill with white diagonal // hatching. They remain included in municipal coverage and the original data, but are excluded from the calculation of the positive colour classes. Missing values are never filled with zero.</p><p>Positive values use the eight fixed intervals selected for this map: up to 0.1%; above 0.1% to 0.25%; above 0.25% to 0.5%; above 0.5% to 0.75%; above 0.75% to 1%; above 1% to 5%; above 5% to 10%; and above 10%.</p><p>These fixed classes have unequal counts and are not deciles. All original percentages, including the smallest positive value and the maximum, retain their native five-decimal API precision in hover/tap. No value is capped or replaced.</p><p>Each upper limit is included in the lower class. The first colour class contains only values strictly greater than zero. The last class is open above 10%, and empty fixed intervals are retained. Filtering a state preserves these same limits.</p>
            <p>Fixed reference: Census 2022. All selected total categories, formulas and source precision are checked against the official IBGE APIs.</p>
            <p>Colours use the eight fixed positive-share intervals shown below the map, including the 0.75% cut. Upper limits belong to the lower class. Observed zeros stay hatched and included in coverage. Original percentages retain five-decimal precision in hover/tap; filtering a state preserves the same fixed limits.</p>
            <p>The maps use IBGE’s 5,570 municipal-level territories and simplified boundaries from 2022. Missing coverage is never filled with zero.</p>
            <p>Official APIs are checked on the dashboard’s monthly cycle. Verified snapshots and optional browser storage retain the last valid result during a temporary source failure.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations and API check</strong></p><div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: 2022. Embedded snapshot verified 2026-11-04.</div>
          </div></details>
          <label class="macro-map-control" for="state-map-foreign-population-percent">State<select id="state-map-foreign-population-percent" data-map-state aria-label="State shared by the municipal maps"><option value="BR">Brazil — all states</option></select></label>
          <button id="download-map-foreign-population-percent" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <p class="macro-map-reference">Light lavender → blue → dark green: lower to higher.<br>Eight fixed positive-share bands: 0.1%, 0.25%, 0.5%, 0.75%, 1%, 5%, 10%; then >10%.<br>Zeros are hatched separately.</p><p class="macro-map-reference"><span aria-hidden="true" style="display:inline-block;width:22px;height:12px;border:1px solid #555;background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#8b8f96 0 4px,#fff 4px 5.35px,#8b8f96 5.35px 8px);vertical-align:middle"></span> Medium grey with white //: observed zero foreign nationals.</p>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: IBGE — <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/10157" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">SIDRA 10157</a>; <a href="https://apisidra.ibge.gov.br/values/t/10157/n6/all/v/1000093/p/2022/c302/6833/c2/6794/c58/95253/d/v1000093%205" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">official API 1</a>.</p>
        </aside></div><p id="status-map-foreign-population-percent" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-catholic-25-plus" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info">
            <p>The denominator is the population aged 25 or older in each municipality, across all religions; it is not the all-age municipal population.</p><p>Religion is Católica Apostólica Romana. Educational attainment and sex are both set to Total.</p><p>The published percentage is retained at five-decimal API precision and displayed with two decimals. It is not recalculated from separately rounded population estimates.</p><p>This age universe differs from other general Census religion releases that cover residents aged 10 or older.</p><p>The national figure is the published IBGE percentage, not the unweighted average of municipalities.</p>
            <p>Fixed reference: Census 2022. All selected total categories, formulas and source precision are checked against the official IBGE APIs.</p>
            <p>Colours show this indicator’s magnitude. The national municipal median gives one observation to each municipality with data; it is not a population-weighted national average. State filters retain the national colour reference.</p>
            <p>The maps use IBGE’s 5,570 municipal-level territories and simplified boundaries from 2022. Missing coverage is never filled with zero.</p>
            <p>Official APIs are checked on the dashboard’s monthly cycle. Verified snapshots and optional browser storage retain the last valid result during a temporary source failure.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations and API check</strong></p><div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: 2022. Embedded snapshot verified 2026-11-04.</div>

    <details id="group-other" class="macro-section-group" open>

    <div id="panel-map-idhm-2010" class="macro-panel macro-map-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-map-idhm-2010">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-map-idhm-2010" class="macro-plot-title">LXIX. Municipal Human Development Index (IDHM), 2010</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-map-idhm-2010" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Income, longevity and education combined into an index from 0 to 1; Census 2010.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-map-idhm-2010" class="macro-map-chart" aria-labelledby="title-map-idhm-2010" aria-describedby="subtitle-map-idhm-2010" aria-busy="true"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-map-coverage" data-map-coverage>Brazil · 5,565 / 5,570 reference territories with data</p>
          <p class="macro-map-detail" data-map-detail>Hover or tap a municipality to see its value.</p>
          <span class="macro-map-announcement" aria-live="polite" data-map-announcement></span></div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-idhm-2010" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info">
            <p>The Municipal Human Development Index combines income, longevity and education. A higher value indicates higher human development under the Atlas Brasil methodology.</p><p>This is the official Census 2010 indicator, not an estimate for 2022 or 2024. The three dimensions are combined by their geometric mean.</p><p>The Ipeadata API series ADH_IDHM supplies 5,564 municipal observations for 2010. Nazária (PI), omitted from that API response, is supplemented at 0.602 from the official PNUD municipal ranking for the same year.</p><p>The five official categories are Very low (&lt;0.500), Low (0.500–0.599), Medium (0.600–0.699), High (0.700–0.799), and Very high (0.800–1.000). Values exactly at a threshold enter the higher category.</p><p>Five territories in the 2022 reference geometry have no value in this 2010 dataset: Mojuí dos Campos, Pescaria Brava, Balneário Rincão, Pinto Bandeira, and Paraíso das Águas. They remain grey with white diagonal hatching; no parent-municipality value is imputed.</p><p>State filtering retains the same official national classes. The map uses the dashboard’s simplified 2022 boundaries, so it is not a reconstruction of municipal boundaries in 2010.</p>
            <p>The fixed 2010 selection is checked through the official API on the dashboard’s monthly cycle. A verified embedded snapshot and optional browser storage retain the last valid data during a temporary API failure. The PNUD supplement for Nazária remains explicitly identified.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations and API check</strong></p><div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: 2010. Embedded snapshot verified 2026-11-04.</div>
          </div></details>
          <label class="macro-map-control" for="state-map-idhm-2010">State<select id="state-map-idhm-2010" data-map-state aria-label="State shared by the municipal maps"><option value="BR">Brazil — all states</option></select></label>
          <button id="download-map-idhm-2010" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <p class="macro-map-reference">Official IDHM categories.<br>Red: lower · green: higher.<br>Fixed reference: 2010.</p>
          <p class="macro-map-reference"><span aria-hidden="true" style="display:inline-block;width:22px;height:12px;border:1px solid #555;background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#8b8f96 0 4px,#fff 4px 5.35px,#8b8f96 5.35px 8px);vertical-align:middle"></span> Medium grey with white //: no 2010 observation.</p>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;ADH_IDHM&#x27;)/Valores" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Ipeadata official API — ADH_IDHM</a>; <a href="https://www.undp.org/pt/brazil/idhm-municipios-2010" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">PNUD — municipal IDHM 2010</a>. Census 2010; boundaries: IBGE 2022.</p>
        </aside></div><p id="status-map-idhm-2010" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>

    <div id="panel-fig10energy" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-fig10energy">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-fig10energy" class="macro-plot-title">LXX. Electricity consumption by sector (GWh)</h3>
          <p class="macro-plot-subtitle">Monthly electricity consumption in Brazil since 1990: commercial, residential, industrial and other uses; GWh, as published.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas">
          <div id="chart-fig10energy" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig10energy" aria-busy="true"></div>
          <div id="presidents-fig10energy" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
            <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div><div id="president-items-fig10energy" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
          </div></div></div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig10energy" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Commercial</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Consumo de energia elétrica - Comercial</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=1402" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>1402</strong></a>. Monthly; GWh.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Residential</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Consumo de energia elétrica - Brasil - Residencial</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=1403" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>1403</strong></a>. Monthly; GWh.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Industrial</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Consumo de energia elétrica - Brasil - Industrial</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=1404" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>1404</strong></a>. Monthly; GWh.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Other uses</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Consumo de energia elétrica - Brasil - Outros</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=1405" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>1405</strong></a>. Monthly; GWh.</p><p>The four official monthly series show electricity consumption in Brazil by consumer class: commercial (1402), residential (1403), industrial (1404), and other uses (1405).</p><p>Each observation is the published consumption for its reference month, in gigawatt-hours (GWh). One GWh equals one million kWh.</p><p>The series are displayed in their original units, without seasonal adjustment, smoothing, rolling accumulation, interpolation, or rebasing. Seasonal and longer-term movements both remain visible.</p><p>Other uses is the source’s remaining published consumer-class category; it is shown separately rather than inferred as a residual from these three other curves.</p><p>The displayed period starts in January 1990. The API also supplies earlier observations, beginning in February 1979; original reference months are retained.</p><p>The vertical scale fits the four observed curves, with a zero lower bound and small upper padding. Legend placement preserves the data range.</p>
            <p>New observations and revisions are checked through the official SGS API on the dashboard’s monthly cycle. The verified embedded history remains available during a temporary source failure.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p><div id="latest-fig10energy" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
          </div></details>
          <button id="download-fig10energy" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <div class="macro-indicators"><p class="macro-key-title">Indicators</p><div id="keys-fig10energy" class="macro-keys" aria-label="Indicator line styles"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: BCB–SGS; official monthly APIs <a href="https://api.bcb.gov.br/dados/serie/bcdata.sgs.1402/dados?formato=json" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">1402</a>, <a href="https://api.bcb.gov.br/dados/serie/bcdata.sgs.1403/dados?formato=json" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">1403</a>, <a href="https://api.bcb.gov.br/dados/serie/bcdata.sgs.1404/dados?formato=json" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">1404</a>, <a href="https://api.bcb.gov.br/dados/serie/bcdata.sgs.1405/dados?formato=json" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">1405</a>. GWh.</p>
        </aside></div><p id="status-fig10energy" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

    <div id="panel-fig10fuels" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-fig10fuels">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-fig10fuels" class="macro-plot-title">LXXI. Fuel consumption by product (thousand barrels/day)</h3>
          <p class="macro-plot-subtitle">Monthly consumption series since 1990: gasoline, LPG, diesel oil and total fuel ethanol; thousand barrels per day.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas">
          <div id="chart-fig10fuels" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig10fuels" aria-busy="true"></div>
          <div id="presidents-fig10fuels" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
            <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div><div id="president-items-fig10fuels" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
          </div></div></div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig10fuels" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Gasoline</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Consumo de derivados de petróleo - Gasolina</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=1393" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>1393</strong></a>. Monthly; thousand barrels/day.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>LPG</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Consumo de derivados de petróleo - GLP</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=1394" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>1394</strong></a>. Monthly; thousand barrels/day.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Diesel oil</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Consumo de derivados de petróleo - Óleo diesel</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=1396" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>1396</strong></a>. Monthly; thousand barrels/day.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Fuel ethanol — total</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Consumo de álcool carburante - Total</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=1401" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>1401</strong></a>. Monthly; thousand barrels/day.</p><p>The four official consumption series cover gasoline (SGS 1393), liquefied petroleum gas — LPG (1394), diesel oil (1396), and total fuel ethanol (1401). The source reported by SGS is the National Agency of Petroleum, Natural Gas and Biofuels (ANP).</p><p>The observation frequency is monthly, while the published volume unit is thousand barrels per day. For example, 500 on the vertical axis means 500,000 barrels per day for that monthly observation.</p><p>The source’s daily-volume unit is retained directly. Values are not multiplied by days in the month, summed over months, converted into a monthly total, seasonally adjusted, or rebased.</p><p>The four product definitions are retained separately as published. LPG means liquefied petroleum gas; total fuel ethanol retains the SGS total category.</p><p>The displayed period begins in January 1990. Dates and values from this period are retained exactly, without filling missing observations or shifting reference months.</p><p>The vertical scale fits all four curves with a zero lower bound and small upper padding. Legends preserve the data range.</p>
            <p>New observations and revisions are checked through the official SGS API on the dashboard’s monthly cycle. The verified embedded history remains available during a temporary source failure.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p><div id="latest-fig10fuels" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
          </div></details>
          <button id="download-fig10fuels" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <div class="macro-indicators"><p class="macro-key-title">Indicators</p><div id="keys-fig10fuels" class="macro-keys" aria-label="Indicator line styles"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: BCB–SGS; official monthly APIs <a href="https://api.bcb.gov.br/dados/serie/bcdata.sgs.1393/dados?formato=json" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">1393</a>, <a href="https://api.bcb.gov.br/dados/serie/bcdata.sgs.1394/dados?formato=json" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">1394</a>, <a href="https://api.bcb.gov.br/dados/serie/bcdata.sgs.1396/dados?formato=json" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">1396</a>, <a href="https://api.bcb.gov.br/dados/serie/bcdata.sgs.1401/dados?formato=json" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">1401</a>. thousand barrels/day.</p>
        </aside></div><p id="status-fig10fuels" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">

          <details id="info-map-water" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
              <p>Residents in occupied permanent private households connected to the public water network and using it as their main supply (category 72144).</p><p>All residents in occupied permanent private households (category 72129).</p><p>Calculated as 100 × numerator / denominator, using unrounded official counts.</p><p>Connection alone is insufficient: the public network must be the main source. Does not measure drinking-water quality, treatment or continuity.</p><p>Fixed reference: Census 2022; the map must not automatically advance to a later census or population estimate.</p><p>Colours indicate the magnitude of this indicator, not a ranking of municipal performance or welfare.</p>
              <p>The colourbar is centred on the national median of available municipal indicator values. Each municipality contributes one observation; with an even number of observations, the median is the average of the two central values. The reference, minimum and maximum remain fixed when a state is selected.</p>
              <p>Linear colour spacing on either side of the national municipal median; red indicates lower values and green higher values.</p>
              <p>The maps use the same 5,570 municipal-level territories and simplified boundaries from IBGE’s 2022 reference. Source territories outside this boundary reference are counted separately; missing values are grey.</p>
              <p>Automatic source checks follow the dashboard’s monthly cycle beginning on the 20th, in America/Fortaleza, when the page is visited or remains open and visible. Revisions to the 2022 observations appear after a successful source check; the Census reference remains fixed at 2022.</p>
              <p>Verified snapshots and optional browser storage keep the last valid published dataset available during a temporary API failure. The shared scheduler retries failed checks.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations and API check</strong></p>
              <div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: 2022. Embedded snapshot verified 2026-10-31.</div>
            </div>
          </details>

          <p id="subtitle-map-favela-selected-share" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Residents inside favelas / residents inside or outside favelas in the selected urban-survey sectors; 656 municipalities covered, Census 2022.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-map-favela-selected-share" class="macro-map-chart" aria-labelledby="title-map-favela-selected-share" aria-describedby="subtitle-map-favela-selected-share" aria-busy="true"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-map-coverage" data-map-coverage>Brazil · 656 / 5,570 municipalities with data</p>
          <p class="macro-map-detail" data-map-detail>Hover or tap a municipality to see its value.</p>
          <span class="macro-map-announcement" aria-live="polite" data-map-announcement></span></div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-favela-selected-share" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info">
            <p>This is a derived share using the two published absolute-count variables, 13550 and 13551.</p><p>The denominator covers only residents of occupied permanent private households in sectors selected for the Urban Survey of Surroundings of Households. It is not the full population of the municipality.</p><p>The table covers municipalities with Favelas e Comunidades Urbanas. Municipalities outside the table remain without coverage and are not assigned zero.</p><p>Two municipalities within table coverage have the official dash marker for the inside-favela count. The IBGE convention identifies that marker as a numerical zero; their derived selected-sector share is zero.</p><p>The requested published percentage variable 1013550 has a different denominator: its own inside-favela universe. With Total categories it is 100% whenever that universe is positive, so it does not measure the favela share of municipal population.</p><p>Medium-grey fill with white diagonal // hatching identifies the 4,914 municipalities outside the table. Two covered municipalities have genuine zero shares and retain the colour for zero.</p><p>Eight fixed percentage bands use the upper limits 1%, 5%, 10%, 20%, 30%, 40% and 50%, followed by above 50%. Each finite upper limit belongs to the lower band. These classes have unequal counts and are not deciles.</p><p>The indicator remains the share of surveyed-sector residents living in Favelas and Urban Communities. It is not the share of the entire municipal population living in these areas.</p><p>Observed zero rates stay in the first colour class. Municipalities outside table coverage retain medium-grey fill with white diagonal // hatching and are excluded from the distribution; missing coverage is never filled with zero.</p><p>All original rates and their full precision are preserved. Filtering a state retains the fixed percentage limits; empty intervals are retained.</p>
            <p>Fixed reference: Census 2022. All selected total categories, formulas and source precision are checked against the official IBGE APIs.</p>
            <p>Colours use eight fixed percentage intervals for residents in the surveyed urban sectors. Observed zero rates belong to the first colour. Medium-grey fill with white diagonals means outside survey coverage. These are unequal-count classes; all original rates and the same limits are retained when filtering a state.</p>
            <p>The maps use IBGE’s 5,570 municipal-level territories and simplified boundaries from 2022. Missing coverage is never filled with zero.</p>
            <p>Official APIs are checked on the dashboard’s monthly cycle. Verified snapshots and optional browser storage retain the last valid result during a temporary source failure.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations and API check</strong></p><div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: 2022. Embedded snapshot verified 2026-11-04.</div>
          </div></details>
          <label class="macro-map-control" for="state-map-favela-selected-share">State<select id="state-map-favela-selected-share" data-map-state aria-label="State shared by the municipal maps"><option value="BR">Brazil — all states</option></select></label>
          <button id="download-map-favela-selected-share" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <p class="macro-map-reference">Light lavender → blue → dark green: lower to higher.<br>Eight fixed bands within surveyed sectors: 1%, 5%, 10%, 20%, 30%, 40%, 50%; then >50%.</p><p class="macro-map-reference"><span aria-hidden="true" style="display:inline-block;width:22px;height:12px;border:1px solid #555;background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#8b8f96 0 4px,#fff 4px 5.35px,#8b8f96 5.35px 8px);vertical-align:middle"></span> Medium grey with white //: outside table coverage.</p>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: IBGE — <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/10206" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">SIDRA 10206</a>; <a href="https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/agregados/10206/periodos/2022/variaveis/13550|13551?localidades=N6[all]&amp;classificacao=86[95251]|14[200]" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">official API 1</a>, <a href="https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/agregados/10206/periodos/2022/variaveis/13550|13551?localidades=N6[all]&amp;classificacao=86[95251]|14[200]" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">official API 2</a>.</p>
        </aside></div><p id="status-map-favela-selected-share" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>
      </div>
    </details>

<script type="module">
// HEIGHT SETTINGS (logical pixels before the PNG scale factor).
// Per plot: height (desktop), height_mobile and height_export override targets.
// min_plot_height applies to the data area; mobile/export variants can override it.
// Targets are minimum requests: readable legends may add the space they need.
// Municipal rank-class settings. Ten groups are deciles.
// Default illiteracy classes; map-field options can override these settings.
// Positive foreign-national shares: zero remains a separate hatched state.
// Favela share is measured within surveyed sectors; zero is a valid rate.
const MUNICIPAL_SURVEY_CLASS_SETTINGS = Object.freeze({
  upperBounds: Object.freeze([1,5,10,20,30,40,50])
});

const MUNICIPAL_FOREIGN_CLASS_SETTINGS = Object.freeze({
  upperBounds: Object.freeze([0.1,0.25,0.5,0.75,1,5,10])
});

const MUNICIPAL_ILLITERACY_CLASS_SETTINGS = Object.freeze({
  bodyMaximum: 5, bodyClasses: 7, tailUpperBounds: Object.freeze([10,20])
});

const MUNICIPAL_COLOUR_CLASS_COUNT = 10;
const MUNICIPAL_CLASS_LEGEND = Object.freeze({
  minColumnWidth: 140, maxColumns: 5, padding: 12,
  header: 18, rowHeight: 17, bottom: 8, swatch: 14, fontSize: 10
});

const CHART_HEIGHTS = Object.freeze({
  desktop: 312, mobile: 340, export: 650,
  compactDesktop: 280, compactMobile: 320,
  minPlot: 230, compactMinPlot: 210,
  insideMax: 450,
  legendGrowth: [16, 32, 48, 64, 96, 144, 208, 320, 480, 800],
  legendSearchMin: 1600, legendSearchExtra: 1000,
  map: { min: 220, desktopMax: 400, mobileMax: 340, export: 520,
    aspect: .95, top: 6, exportTop: 66, footer: 10, exportFooter: 78, footerGap: 24 }
});

function positiveHeight(value) {
  return Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? value : null;
}

function chartHeight(plot = {}, {mobile = false, forExport = false} = {}) {
  const key = forExport ? "height_export" : mobile ? "height_mobile" : "height";
  const configured = positiveHeight(plot[key]);
  if (configured !== null) return configured;
  if (!forExport && plot.compact_plot === true) {
    return mobile ? CHART_HEIGHTS.compactMobile : CHART_HEIGHTS.compactDesktop;
  }
  return forExport ? CHART_HEIGHTS.export : mobile ? CHART_HEIGHTS.mobile : CHART_HEIGHTS.desktop;
}

function minimumPlotHeight(plot = {}, {mobile = false, forExport = false} = {}) {
  const key = forExport ? "min_plot_height_export" : mobile ? "min_plot_height_mobile" : "min_plot_height";
  return positiveHeight(plot[key]) ?? positiveHeight(plot.min_plot_height) ??
    (plot.compact_plot === true ? positiveHeight(plot.legend_min_plot_height) ?? CHART_HEIGHTS.compactMinPlot : CHART_HEIGHTS.minPlot);
}

function insideLegendHeightLimit(plot = {}) {
  // true opts into the shared limit; a number remains an explicit plot override.
  return plot.legend_inside_max_height === true ? CHART_HEIGHTS.insideMax : positiveHeight(plot.legend_inside_max_height);
}

function configureChartHeights() {
  const root = document.getElementById("macro-dashboard");
  if (!root) return;
  root.style.setProperty("--macro-chart-height", `${CHART_HEIGHTS.desktop}px`);
  root.style.setProperty("--macro-chart-height-mobile", `${CHART_HEIGHTS.mobile}px`);
  root.style.setProperty("--macro-map-min-height", `${CHART_HEIGHTS.map.min}px`);
  const mobile = window.matchMedia("(max-width: 600px)").matches;
  // Reserve each configured target before lazy loading; legends resolve later.
  for (const plot of PLOTS) {
    const chart = document.getElementById(`chart-${plot.id}`);
    if (chart) chart.style.height = `${chartHeight(plot, {mobile})}px`;
  }
}

function monthIndex(date) {
  return Number(date.slice(0, 4)) * 12 + Number(date.slice(5, 7)) - 1;
}

function monthDate(index) {
  return `${Math.floor(index / 12)}-${String(index % 12 + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-01`;
}

function clipped(points, start) {
  return points.filter(point => point[0] >= start);
}

function rolling(points, size, operation) {
  const output = [];
  for (let i = size - 1; i < points.length; i++) {
    const window = points.slice(i - size + 1, i + 1);
    if (monthIndex(window.at(-1)[0]) - monthIndex(window[0][0]) !== size - 1) continue;
    const values = window.map(point => point[1]);
    let value;
    if (operation === "compound") value = (values.reduce((p, x) => p * (1 + x / 100), 1) - 1) * 100;
    else value = values.reduce((sum, x) => sum + x, 0) / (operation === "mean" ? size : 1);
    output.push([points[i][0], value]);
  }
  return output;
}

function monthlyFromYTD(points) {
  return points.flatMap((point, i) => {
    if (point[0].slice(5, 7) === "01") return [point];
    const previous = points[i - 1];
    if (!previous || monthIndex(point[0]) - monthIndex(previous[0]) !== 1 ||
        previous[0].slice(0, 4) !== point[0].slice(0, 4)) return [];
    return [[point[0], point[1] - previous[1]]];
  });
}

function validatePopulationPyramid(input) {
  if (!input || input.reference_year !== 2022 || input.geographic_level !== "N1" ||
      String(input.geographic_code) !== "1" || !Array.isArray(input.ages) || input.ages.length !== 21) {
    throw new Error("Invalid national Census 2022 pyramid dataset.");
  }
  const integer = value => typeof value === "number" && Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value >= 0;
  const total = input.denominator_both_sexes_all_ages;
  if (!integer(total) || total === 0 || !integer(input.male_total) || !integer(input.female_total) ||
      input.male_total + input.female_total !== total) throw new Error("Invalid pyramid population totals.");
  const seen = new Set();
  let men = 0, women = 0;
  const ages = input.ages.map((row,index) => {
    const expected = POPULATION_PYRAMID_SEED.ages[index];
    if (String(row.age_category) !== String(expected.age_category) || row.age_group !== expected.age_group ||
        seen.has(String(row.age_category)) || !integer(row.male_count) || !integer(row.female_count) ||
        !integer(row.total_count) || row.total_count !== row.male_count + row.female_count) {
      throw new Error("Incomplete or inconsistent age-sex population cells.");
    }
    seen.add(String(row.age_category)); men += row.male_count; women += row.female_count;
    return {...expected,male_count:row.male_count,female_count:row.female_count,total_count:row.total_count,
      male_percent_total:100*row.male_count/total,female_percent_total:100*row.female_count/total,
      both_sexes_percent_total:100*row.total_count/total};
  });
  if (men !== input.male_total || women !== input.female_total) throw new Error("Age groups do not match the official sex totals.");
  return {...input,table:9514,variable:93,reference_year:2022,geographic_level:"N1",geographic_code:"1",
    denominator_both_sexes_all_ages:total,ages,male_percent_total:100*men/total,female_percent_total:100*women/total};
}

function parsePopulationPyramid(payload) {

      payload[0].unidade !== "Pessoas" || !Array.isArray(payload[0].resultados)) {

  }

    if (!Array.isArray(result.classificacoes) || result.classificacoes.length !== 3) throw new Error("Invalid Census classifications.");
    for (const item of result.classificacoes) {
      const keys = Object.keys(item.categoria || {});

      categories.set(String(item.id),keys[0]);
    }
    const sex=categories.get("2"),age=categories.get("287");
    if (!["6794","4","5"].includes(sex) || !allowedAges.has(age) || categories.get("286") !== "113635" ||
        !Array.isArray(result.series) || result.series.length !== 1) throw new Error("Unexpected Census selection.");
    const record=result.series[0],key=`${sex}:${age}`,years=Object.keys(record.serie || {});
    const text=record.serie?.["2022"];
    if (String(record.localidade?.id) !== "1" || record.localidade?.nivel?.id !== "N1" ||
        years.length !== 1 || years[0] !== "2022" || typeof text !== "string" || !/^\d+$/.test(text) ||
        !Number.isSafeInteger(Number(text)) || cells.has(key)) throw new Error("Invalid, duplicate or suppressed Census observation.");
    cells.set(key,Number(text));
  }
  if (cells.size !== 66) throw new Error("Incomplete pyramid API response.");
  const input={reference_year:2022,geographic_level:"N1",geographic_code:"1",
    denominator_both_sexes_all_ages:cells.get("6794:100362"),male_total:cells.get("4:100362"),female_total:cells.get("5:100362"),
    ages:POPULATION_PYRAMID_SEED.ages.map(row=>({...row,male_count:cells.get(`4:${row.age_category}`),
      female_count:cells.get(`5:${row.age_category}`),total_count:cells.get(`6794:${row.age_category}`)}))};

}

function createPopulationPyramidController(options = {}) {
  const fetcher=options.fetcher || globalThis.fetch, now=options.now || (()=>Date.now());
