    }
  } catch(error) { /* Storage failure or invalid cache leaves the verified seed intact. */ }
  const state=()=>({data,source,checkedAt,referenceYear:2022});
  return {current:state,async refresh({force=false}={}){
    if(pending)return pending;
    const time=now();
    if(!force && ((checkedAt>0 && time-checkedAt<interval) || time-lastAttempt<retry))return state();
    lastAttempt=time;
    pending=(async()=>{
      const abort=new AbortController(),timer=setTimeout(()=>abort.abort(),options.timeoutMs ?? 20000);
      try {
        const response=await fetcher(POPULATION_PYRAMID_API,{signal:abort.signal,cache:"no-store"});
        if(!response.ok)throw new Error("IBGE pyramid API unavailable.");
        const candidate=parsePopulationPyramid(await response.json());
        data=candidate;source="api";checkedAt=now();
        try {storage?.setItem(POPULATION_PYRAMID_CACHE_KEY,JSON.stringify({version:POPULATION_PYRAMID_CACHE_VERSION,checkedAt,data}));}
        catch(error){/* The valid in-memory dataset remains available without storage. */}
        return state();
      } finally {clearTimeout(timer);}
    })();
    try{return await pending;}finally{pending=null;}
  }};
}

function buildPopulationPyramidSeries(plot, input = POPULATION_PYRAMID_SEED) {
  const data=validatePopulationPyramid(input);
  return plot.traces.map(spec=>{
    if(!["male","female"].includes(spec.sex))throw new Error("Invalid pyramid sex specification.");
    return {spec,referenceYear:2022,denominator:data.denominator_both_sexes_all_ages,
      points:data.ages.map(row=>[row.age_group,row[`${spec.sex}_percent_total`]]),
      counts:data.ages.map(row=>row[`${spec.sex}_count`])};
  });
}

function populationPyramidFigure(plot, series, width=520, options={}) {
  const mobile=options.mobile===true || width<500,forExport=options.forExport===true;
  if(series.length!==2 || series.some(trace=>trace.points.length!==21 || trace.counts.length!==21))throw new Error("Incomplete pyramid series.");
  const margins=options.margins || (forExport ? {l:70,r:30,t:86,b:112} : {l:58,r:mobile?12:22,t:28,b:54});
  const height=Math.max(options.height ?? chartHeight(plot,{mobile,forExport}),
    margins.t+margins.b+minimumPlotHeight(plot,{mobile,forExport}),margins.t+margins.b+series[0].points.length*19);
  const maximum=Math.max(...series.flatMap(trace=>trace.points.map(point=>point[1])));
  const radius=Math.max(.5,Math.ceil(maximum*1.06/.5)*.5),step=radius<=5?1:2;
  const ticks=[];for(let tick=-Math.floor(radius/step)*step;tick<=radius;tick+=step)ticks.push(tick);
  const data=series.map(trace=>({type:"bar",orientation:"h",name:trace.spec.legendLabel || trace.spec.label,
    x:trace.points.map(point=>(trace.spec.sex==="male"?-1:1)*point[1]),y:trace.points.map(point=>point[0]),
    customdata:trace.points.map((point,index)=>[trace.counts[index],point[1]]),base:0,
    marker:{color:trace.spec.color,line:{width:0}},width:.8,showlegend:true,
    hovertemplate:`%{y} years<br><b>%{customdata[0]:,d} residents</b><br>%{customdata[1]:.2f}% of Brazil's total population<extra>${trace.spec.label}</extra>`}));
  const title=forExport ? wrappedTitle(plot.title,width,14)+(plot.subtitle?`<br><span style="font-size:11px">${wrappedTitle(plot.subtitle,width,11)}</span>`:"") : "";
  const layout={width,height,margin:margins,font:{family:'"Times New Roman", Times, serif',size:mobile?11:12,color:"#222"},
    separators:".,",paper_bgcolor:"#fff",plot_bgcolor:"#fff",barmode:"relative",bargap:.16,
    title:{text:title,x:margins.l/width,xanchor:"left",font:{size:14}},
    xaxis:{type:"linear",range:[-radius,radius],tickmode:"array",tickvals:ticks,ticktext:ticks.map(tick=>tick===0?"0":`${Math.abs(tick)}%`),
      title:{text:plot.axis.title,standoff:8,font:{size:mobile?11:12}},fixedrange:true,showgrid:true,
      gridcolor:"rgba(0,0,0,.13)",griddash:"dot",zeroline:true,zerolinecolor:"#666",zerolinewidth:1},
    yaxis:{type:"category",categoryorder:"array",categoryarray:series[0].points.map(point=>point[0]),
      range:[-.6,20.65],tickmode:"array",tickvals:series[0].points.map(point=>point[0]),
      title:{text:"Age (years)",standoff:7},fixedrange:true,showgrid:false,zeroline:false},
    legend:{title:{text:"Sex",font:{size:11}},x:.99,y:.99,xanchor:"right",yanchor:"top",font:{size:11},
      bgcolor:"rgba(255,255,255,.96)",bordercolor:"#000",borderwidth:1,itemclick:false,itemdoubleclick:false},
    shapes:[],annotations:[],showlegend:true,hovermode:"closest",dragmode:false};
  if(forExport)layout.annotations.push({xref:"paper",yref:"paper",x:0,y:0,yshift:-58,xanchor:"left",yanchor:"top",showarrow:false,
    font:{size:9},text:[...(plot.export_notes || []),plot.source_caption].filter(Boolean).map(line=>wrappedTitle(line,width-margins.l-margins.r,9)).join("<br>")});
  return {data,layout,config:{locale:"en",responsive:true,displayModeBar:false,displaylogo:false,scrollZoom:false,doubleClick:false},
    legendInfo:{kind:"population-pyramid",inside:null,external:false,overlay:false,items:[],width,height,margins}};
}

function buildPopulationPyramidExportFigure(plot, series) {
  return populationPyramidFigure(plot,series,1000,{forExport:true,height:chartHeight(plot,{forExport:true})});
}

async function initializePopulationPyramid(plot) {
  const root=document.getElementById(`panel-${plot.id}`),chart=document.getElementById(`chart-${plot.id}`),
    status=document.getElementById(`status-${plot.id}`),button=document.getElementById(`download-${plot.id}`),
    latest=document.getElementById(`latest-${plot.id}`);
  const controller=createPopulationPyramidController();
  let series=buildPopulationPyramidSeries(plot,controller.current().data),lastDimensions,task=Promise.resolve();
  const enqueue=action=>{const next=task.then(action);task=next.catch(()=>{});return next;};
  const fill=()=>{
    const state=controller.current(),data=state.data,n=new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US");
    latest.textContent=`Census 2022 · Brazil: ${n.format(data.denominator_both_sexes_all_ages)} residents. Men ${n.format(data.male_total)} (${data.male_percent_total.toFixed(2)}%); women ${n.format(data.female_total)} (${data.female_percent_total.toFixed(2)}%). ${state.source==="seed"?"Verified embedded snapshot":state.source==="api"?"Official IBGE API verified":"Validated API cache"}.`;
  };
  async function draw(nextSeries){
    series=nextSeries;fill();
    const mobile=window.matchMedia("(max-width: 600px)").matches,width=chart.clientWidth;
    if(width<120 || root.closest("details.macro-section-group")?.open===false)return;
    const figure=populationPyramidFigure(plot,series,width,{mobile,height:chartHeight(plot,{mobile})});
    root.style.setProperty("--macro-plot-top",`${figure.layout.margin.t}px`);chart.style.height=`${figure.layout.height}px`;
    await Plotly.react(chart,figure.data,figure.layout,figure.config);
    lastDimensions={width,height:figure.layout.height,mobile};chart.setAttribute("aria-busy","false");
  }
  registerSectionRedraw(plot,root,()=>void enqueue(()=>draw(series)).catch(()=>{}));
  try {
    await loadPlotly();await enqueue(()=>draw(series));button.disabled=false;status.hidden=true;
    button.onclick=async()=>{
      button.disabled=true;
      try{await enqueue(async()=>{const figure=buildPopulationPyramidExportFigure(plot,series);
        await Plotly.downloadImage({data:figure.data,layout:figure.layout,config:figure.config},{format:"png",
          filename:`${plot.id}-ibge-sidra-9514-brazil-2022`,width:1000,height:figure.layout.height,scale:2});});}
      catch(error){status.textContent="Unable to download the figure. Please try again.";status.hidden=false;}
      finally{button.disabled=false;}
    };
    if(typeof ResizeObserver!=="undefined"){
      let scheduled=false;
      new ResizeObserver(()=>{
        const mobile=window.matchMedia("(max-width: 600px)").matches;
        if(!lastDimensions || (Math.abs(chart.clientWidth-lastDimensions.width)<1 && Math.abs(chart.clientHeight-lastDimensions.height)<1 && mobile===lastDimensions.mobile) || scheduled)return;
        scheduled=true;requestAnimationFrame(()=>{scheduled=false;void enqueue(()=>draw(series)).catch(()=>{});});
      }).observe(chart);
    }
    const refresh=async()=>{
      try{const state=await controller.refresh(),next=buildPopulationPyramidSeries(plot,state.data);
        if(JSON.stringify(next.map(trace=>trace.counts))!==JSON.stringify(series.map(trace=>trace.counts)))await enqueue(()=>draw(next));
        else fill();status.hidden=true;
      }catch(error){fill();status.textContent="Official IBGE API temporarily unavailable; the verified Census 2022 snapshot remains displayed.";status.hidden=false;}
    };
    registerRefresh(plot,refresh);void refresh();
  } catch(error){
    chart.setAttribute("aria-busy","false");status.textContent="Unable to load the chart. Please reload the page.";status.hidden=false;
    let lastAttempt=Date.now();registerRefresh(plot,async()=>{if(Date.now()-lastAttempt<300000)return;lastAttempt=Date.now();await initializePopulationPyramid(plot);});
  }
}

function buildSeries(plot, raw) {
  if (plot.kind === "population-pyramid") return buildPopulationPyramidSeries(plot, raw?.ages ? raw : POPULATION_PYRAMID_SEED);
  return plot.traces.map(spec => {
    const source = raw[spec.code];
    if (!Array.isArray(source) || !source.length) throw new Error(`Missing series ${spec.code}`);
    let points;
    let priceBase;
    if (spec.op === "share_of_total") {
      const denominator = raw[spec.denominator];
      if (!Array.isArray(denominator) || !denominator.length) throw new Error(`Missing series ${spec.denominator}`);
      const totals = new Map(denominator);
      points = source.filter(([date]) => totals.get(date) > 0)
        .map(([date, value]) => [date, value / totals.get(date) * 100]);
    } else if (spec.op === "compound12") {
      points = rolling(source, 12, "compound");
    } else if (spec.op === "real_selic12") {
      const inflation = raw[spec.cpi];
      if (!Array.isArray(inflation) || !inflation.length) throw new Error(`Missing series ${spec.cpi}`);
      const inflationByMonth = new Map(inflation);
      points = rolling(source, 12, "compound")
        .filter(([date, nominal]) => Number.isFinite(nominal) && Number.isFinite(inflationByMonth.get(date)) && inflationByMonth.get(date) > -100)
        .map(([date, nominal]) => [date, 100 * ((1 + nominal / 100) / (1 + inflationByMonth.get(date) / 100) - 1)]);
    } else if (spec.op === "sum12") {
      // Monthly flows are added once; this is not a year-to-date series.
      points = rolling(source, 12, "sum");
    } else if (spec.op === "rebase_year") {
      const reference = source.filter(point => Number(point[0].slice(0, 4)) === spec.baseYear);
      const expected = spec.frequency === "quarterly" ? 4 : 12;
      if (reference.length !== expected) throw new Error(`Incomplete reference year for SGS ${spec.code}`);
      const base = reference.reduce((sum, point) => sum + point[1], 0) / reference.length;
      if (!Number.isFinite(base) || base === 0) throw new Error(`Invalid reference year for SGS ${spec.code}`);
      points = source.map(point => [point[0], 100 * point[1] / base]);
    } else if (spec.op === "net_exports_rebase_year") {
      // A fixed-2019-weight volume-balance proxy, rebased after subtraction.
      // The negative reference balance is valid and its sign is retained.
      const imports = raw[spec.subtractCode];
      if (!Array.isArray(imports) || !imports.length) throw new Error(`Missing series ${spec.subtractCode}`);
      const referenceMean = (values, code) => {
        const reference = values.filter(point => Number(point[0].slice(0, 4)) === spec.baseYear);
        if (reference.length !== 4) throw new Error(`Incomplete reference year for SGS ${code}`);
        const mean = reference.reduce((sum, point) => sum + point[1], 0) / 4;
        if (!Number.isFinite(mean) || mean <= 0) throw new Error(`Invalid reference year for SGS ${code}`);
        return mean;
      };
      const exportsMean = referenceMean(source, spec.code);
      const importsMean = referenceMean(imports, spec.subtractCode);
      const exportsWeight = spec.exportsWeight, importsWeight = spec.importsWeight;
      const baseBalance = exportsWeight - importsWeight;
      if (!(exportsWeight > 0) || !(importsWeight > 0) || !Number.isFinite(baseBalance) || baseBalance === 0) {
        throw new Error("Invalid net-exports reference balance");
      }
      const importsByDate = new Map(imports);
      points = source.filter(point => importsByDate.has(point[0])).map(([date, value]) => [
        date, 100 * (exportsWeight * value / exportsMean -
          importsWeight * importsByDate.get(date) / importsMean) / baseBalance
      ]);
    } else if (spec.op === "mean3") {
      points = rolling(clipped(source, plot.start), 3, "mean");
    } else if (spec.op === "year_end_december") {
      // This annual source reports December coverage under a January year label.
      points = source.map(([date, value]) => [`${date.slice(0, 4)}-12-01`, value]);
    } else if (spec.op === "ytd_sum12") {
      points = rolling(clipped(monthlyFromYTD(source), plot.start), 12, "sum");
    } else if (spec.op === "bndes_original_gdp") {
      // Explicit replication of Fig. 3(a): sum 12 original YTD observations.
      const numerator = rolling(clipped(source, plot.start), 12, "sum");
      const denominator = new Map(rolling(clipped(raw[spec.denominator], plot.start), 12, "sum"));
      points = numerator.filter(point => denominator.has(point[0]) && denominator.get(point[0]) !== 0)
        .map(point => [point[0], 100 * point[1] / denominator.get(point[0])]);
    } else if (spec.op === "bndes_gdp") {
      const numerator = rolling(clipped(monthlyFromYTD(source), plot.start), 12, "sum");
      const denominator = new Map(rolling(clipped(raw[spec.denominator], plot.start), 12, "sum"));
      points = numerator.filter(point => denominator.has(point[0]) && denominator.get(point[0]) !== 0)
        .map(point => [point[0], 100 * point[1] / denominator.get(point[0])]);
    } else if (spec.op === "deflate_ipca_latest") {
      const cpi = raw[spec.cpi];
      if (!Array.isArray(cpi) || !cpi.length) throw new Error(`Missing series ${spec.cpi}`);
      const monthlyCpi = new Map(cpi.filter(point => Number.isFinite(point[1]) && point[1] > -100));
      const common = source.filter(point => monthlyCpi.has(point[0]) && Number.isFinite(point[1]));
      priceBase = common.map(point => point[0]).sort().at(-1);
      if (!priceBase) throw new Error("No common transfer and IPCA reference month is available.");
      // A payment in month t is converted using rates t+1 through the base month.
      // Stop at a missing CPI month: earlier amounts cannot cross that gap.
      const factors = new Map([[priceBase, 1]]);
      let month = monthIndex(priceBase), factor = 1;
      while (monthlyCpi.has(monthDate(month))) {
        factor *= 1 + monthlyCpi.get(monthDate(month)) / 100;
        if (!Number.isFinite(factor) || factor <= 0) break;
        factors.set(monthDate(month - 1), factor);
        month--;
      }
      points = source.filter(point => point[0] <= priceBase && factors.has(point[0]))
        .map(point => [point[0], point[1] * factors.get(point[0])]);
    } else if (spec.op === "gdp_real" || spec.op === "deflate_ipca") {
      let level = 1;
      const index = new Map(raw[spec.cpi].map(point => {
        level *= 1 + point[1] / 100;
        return [point[0], level];
      }));
      const base = index.get(spec.base);
      if (!Number.isFinite(base)) throw new Error(`The price reference ${spec.base} is unavailable.`);
      points = source.filter(point => index.has(point[0]))
        .map(point => [point[0], point[1] * base / index.get(point[0])]);
    } else {
      points = source;
    }
    const factor = spec.factor ?? 1;
    points = clipped(points, plot.start).map(point => [point[0], point[1] * factor]);
    if (!points.length) throw new Error(`No observations for ${plot.id}`);
    return priceBase ? { spec, points, priceBase } : { spec, points };
  });
}

function isIpeaCode(code) {
  return typeof code === "string" && /^ipea:[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$/.test(code);
}

function isRegionalIpeaSeries(seriesCode) {
  return ["SUS_NMMED10MHUF", "SIS_NMENF1000HUF", "SIS_NMODN1000HUF"].includes(seriesCode) ||
    seriesCode === "FAM_PBF" || seriesCode === "VAL_PBF12" ||
    /^PNADCT_TXINFORMUF(?:_(?:1417|1824|2539|4059|60M|BRA|HOM|MUL|PRD|NEG))?$/.test(seriesCode);
}

function dependencies(plot) {
  if (plot.kind === "population-pyramid") return [];
  return [...new Set(plot.traces.flatMap(trace => [trace.code, trace.cpi, trace.denominator, trace.subtractCode]
    .filter(code => Number.isFinite(code) || isIpeaCode(code) || isPublicCode(code))))];
}

function resolvedPriceBase(plot, series) {
  const base = series.find(trace => trace.priceBase)?.priceBase;
  if (!base) return "latest available month";
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", { month: "long", year: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" })
    .format(new Date(base + "T12:00:00Z"));
}

function resolvePriceBaseText(text, plot, series) {
  const latestYear = series.flatMap(trace => trace.points).map(point => point[0].slice(0, 4)).sort().at(-1) || "latest available year";
  return String(text).replaceAll("{priceBase}", resolvedPriceBase(plot, series)).replaceAll("{lastYear}", latestYear);
}

function axisBounds(spec, series, hardMinimum) {
  if (spec.fixed === true && Number.isFinite(spec.min) && Number.isFinite(spec.max) && spec.max > spec.min) {
    return [spec.min, spec.max];
  }
  const values = series.flatMap(trace => trace.points.map(point => point[1]));
  const minimum = Math.min(...values);
  const maximum = Math.max(...values);
  const padding = spec.fit_data === true ? Math.max((maximum - minimum) * .015, Math.abs(maximum) * .001, .01) :
    spec.tight === true ? Math.max((maximum - minimum) * .04, Math.abs(maximum) * .001, .0001) :
    Math.max((maximum - minimum) * .05, Math.abs(maximum) * .015, .01);
  let lower = Number.isFinite(spec.min) ? Math.min(spec.min, minimum - padding) : minimum - padding;
  let upper = Number.isFinite(spec.max) ? Math.max(spec.max, maximum + padding) : maximum + padding;
  if (spec.min === 0 && minimum >= 0) lower = 0;
  if (spec.fixedMin === true && Number.isFinite(spec.min)) lower = spec.min;
  if (Number.isFinite(hardMinimum)) {
    lower = hardMinimum;
    upper = Math.max(hardMinimum + 5, Math.ceil(upper / 5) * 5);
  }
  if (spec.fit_data === true) {
    const step = Number.isFinite(spec.niceStep) && spec.niceStep > 0 ? spec.niceStep : 1;
    lower = Math.floor(lower / step) * step;
    upper = Math.ceil(upper / step) * step;
  }
  if (Number.isFinite(spec.tickStep) && spec.tickStep > 0) {
    upper = Math.max(lower + spec.tickStep, Math.ceil(upper / spec.tickStep) * spec.tickStep);
  }
  return [lower, upper];
}

function dateLabel(date, frequency = "monthly") {
  if (frequency === true || frequency === "annual") return date.slice(0, 4);
  if (frequency === "quarterly") return `Q${Math.ceil(Number(date.slice(5, 7)) / 3)} ${date.slice(0, 4)}`;
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", { month: "short", year: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" })
    .format(new Date(date + "T12:00:00Z"));
}

function addGaps(points, frequency) {
  const output = [];
  for (const point of points) {
    const previous = output.at(-1);
    const difference = previous ? monthIndex(point[0]) - monthIndex(previous[0]) : 0;
    const step = frequency === true || frequency === "annual" ? 12 : frequency === "quarterly" ? 3 : 1;
    if (difference > step) output.push([monthDate(monthIndex(previous[0]) + step), null]);
    output.push(point);
  }
  return output;
}

function rgba(hex, alpha) {
  const fullHex = hex.length === 4 ? "#" + [...hex.slice(1)].map(c => c + c).join("") : hex;
  const rgb = [1, 3, 5].map(i => parseInt(fullHex.slice(i, i + 2), 16));
  return `rgba(${rgb.join(",")},${alpha})`;
}

function wrappedTitle(text, width, fontSize) {
  const limit = Math.max(26, Math.floor((width - 24) / (fontSize * .49)));
  const lines = [""];
  for (const word of text.split(/\s+/)) {
    const line = lines.at(-1);
    if (line && line.length + word.length + 1 > limit) lines.push(word);
    else lines[lines.length - 1] += (line ? " " : "") + word;
  }
  return lines.join("<br>");
}

function chooseLegend(series, ranges, count, width) {
  const boxWidth = Math.min(.45, 105 / Math.max(220, width - 70));
  const boxHeight = Math.min(.7, (count * 17 + 24) / 285);
  const candidates = [
    { x: .02, y: .98, xanchor: "left", yanchor: "top", left: 0, top: 0 },
    { x: .98, y: .98, xanchor: "right", yanchor: "top", left: 1 - boxWidth, top: 0 },
    { x: .02, y: .02, xanchor: "left", yanchor: "bottom", left: 0, top: 1 - boxHeight },
    { x: .98, y: .02, xanchor: "right", yanchor: "bottom", left: 1 - boxWidth, top: 1 - boxHeight }
  ];
  const start = Math.min(...series.flatMap(trace => trace.points.map(point => Date.parse(point[0]))));
  const end = Math.max(...series.flatMap(trace => trace.points.map(point => Date.parse(point[0]))));
  const scored = candidates.map(candidate => {
    let score = 0;
    for (const trace of series) {
      const range = ranges[trace.spec.axis || "y"];
      for (const point of trace.points) {
        const x = (Date.parse(point[0]) - start) / Math.max(1, end - start);
        const y = 1 - (point[1] - range[0]) / Math.max(.01, range[1] - range[0]);
        if (x >= candidate.left && x <= candidate.left + boxWidth &&
            y >= candidate.top && y <= candidate.top + boxHeight) score++;
      }
    }
    return { candidate, score };
  }).sort((a, b) => a.score - b.score);
  const { left, top, ...position } = scored[0].candidate;
  return position;
}

/**
 * Place a vertical Presidents legend only where it clears every data mark.
 *
 * `width` and `height` are the logical Plotly canvas dimensions, before PNG
 * scaling. `margins` must be the margins of the figure actually being drawn.
 * `series` is the unchanged buildSeries output: [{spec, points:[[ISO,value]]}].
 * Pass `preferredPosition` to preserve an existing zero-collision position.
 * An external=true result asks the caller to render its external legend.
 *
 * Geometry is rasterized into a conservative two-pixel occupancy grid. A
 * summed-area table then makes every candidate-box collision test O(1).
 */
function chooseLegendPlacement({
  series, ranges, start, end, width, height, margins,
  labels, fontSize = 10, titleSize = 10,
  preferredPosition = null, previousPosition = null
}) {
  const padding = 4;
  const cell = 2;
  const entries = Array.isArray(labels) ? labels.map(String) : [];
  const font = Number.isFinite(fontSize) ? fontSize : 10;
  const titleFont = Number.isFinite(titleSize) ? titleSize : 10;
  const plotWidth = Math.max(0, width - (margins?.l || 0) - (margins?.r || 0));
  const plotHeight = Math.max(0, height - (margins?.t || 0) - (margins?.b || 0));

  // Times-like character advances, calibrated to Plotly 3.1 SVG rectangles:
  // 8 labels => 87x175 @font10/title10; 74x173 @font7/title8.
  function emWidth(text) {
    const widths = {
      " ": .25, i: .278, l: .278, I: .333, j: .278, t: .278,
      f: .333, r: .333, s: .389, a: .444, c: .444, e: .444,
      v: .5, x: .5, y: .5, z: .444, m: .778, w: .722,
      B: .667, F: .556, H: .722, L: .611, P: .556,
      M: .889, W: .944, T: .611
    };
    return [...text].reduce((sum, character) => sum +
      (widths[character] ?? (/[A-Z]/.test(character) ? .667 : .5)), 0);
  }
  const widest = Math.max(0, ...entries.map(label => emWidth(label) * font * 1.04));
  const legendWidth = entries.length ? Math.ceil(Math.max(44 + widest, 12 + emWidth("Presidents") * titleFont * 1.04)) : 0;
