  const selected={type:"GeometryCollection",geometries},features=libraries.topojson.feature(topology,selected).features;
  features.forEach(feature=>{feature.id=municipalCode(feature);});
  const dims=municipalDimensions(width,mobile,exported,classified);
  const collection={type:"FeatureCollection",features};
  const projection=libraries.d3.geoMercator().fitExtent([[dims.left+6,dims.top+6],[dims.width-dims.right-6,dims.top+dims.mapHeight-6]],collection);
  const path=libraries.d3.geoPath(projection).digits(2);
  const legend=classified ? {...dims.classificationLegend,mapLeft:dims.left} : municipalLegendPlacement(features.map(feature=>path.bounds(feature)),dims,mobile,exported);
  if(legend.mode==="reserved-left")projection.fitExtent([[legend.mapLeft+6,dims.top+6],[dims.width-dims.right-6,dims.top+dims.mapHeight-6]],collection);
  const outline=libraries.topojson.mesh(topology,selected,(a,b)=>a===b);
  const borders=libraries.topojson.mesh(topology,selected,(a,b)=>municipalCode(a).slice(0,2)!==municipalCode(b).slice(0,2));
  return {dims,legend,paths:features.map(feature=>({code:feature.id,path:path(feature)})),outline:path(outline),borders:path(borders),features,projection};
}
function municipalSubtitle(field,year) {
  if (field.subtitle) return field.subtitle;
  if (field.key==="gdpMunicipal") return `Annual GDP at current prices; BRL (colourbar: BRL billion), ${year}.`;
  if (field.key==="gdpPerCapita") return `Annual GDP per resident at current prices; BRL per person, ${year}.`;
  if (field.key==="pbfTotal") return `Total payments in December ${year}; BRL (colourbar: BRL million).`;
  if (field.key==="pbfAverage") return `Total December ${year} payments divided by benefits paid; BRL per benefit.`;
  if (field.key==="income") return `Mean monthly nominal household income per person; BRL, Census ${year}.`;
  if (field.key==="schooling") return `Mean years of study among people aged 25 or more; Census ${year}.`;
  return `Brazil’s cash transfer programme; number of benefits paid in December ${year}.`;
}

function municipalValue(field,value,rawValue) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) && field.missingLabel) return field.missingLabel;
  if (field.valueTransform === "ln" && Number.isFinite(value)) {
    return `ln(population): ${municipalNumber(value,field.decimals)}${Number.isFinite(rawValue) ? `; ${municipalNumber(rawValue,0)} people` : ""}`;
  }
  const unit=field.unit || '';
  return unit.startsWith('BRL') ? `BRL ${municipalNumber(value,field.decimals)}${unit.slice(3)}` : `${municipalNumber(value,field.decimals)} ${unit}`;
}

function municipalLayerStatus(layer) {
  if (layer.fixedSnapshot) return "";
  if (layer.status==="waiting") return "Waiting for matching December references in the payment and benefit-count series. Keeping the last valid average.";
  if (layer.status==="stale") return "Source temporarily unavailable. Keeping the last valid published dataset; API checks will retry.";
  if (layer.status==="updating") return "Checking the source API for published updates…";
  if (layer.status==="seed") return "Verified snapshot available; the source API will be checked when the map is opened.";
  return "";
}

// Independent municipal data adapter. The host supplies its existing day-20
// cycle and scheduler; this adapter creates no timer or page-level listeners.
// Official IBGE Census 2022 municipal counts; the census year is deliberately fixed.
const CENSUS_YEAR = 2022;
const CENSUS_EXPECTED_MUNICIPALITIES = 5570;
const CENSUS_YOUNG_AGES = ['93070', '93084', '93085'];
const CENSUS_OLDER_AGES = ['93096', '93097', '93098', '49108', '49109', '60040', '60041', '6653'];
const CENSUS_REQUESTS = {
  water: {table: 6894, variable: '382', varyingClass: '1821', categories: ['72129', '72144'],
    fixedClasses: {'58': '95253', '86': '95251'}},
  sewer: {table: 7555, variable: '382', varyingClass: '11558', categories: ['46292', '46290'],
    fixedClasses: {'58': '95253', '86': '95251'}},
  waste: {table: 9541, variable: '382', varyingClass: '67', categories: ['10972', '2520'],
    fixedClasses: {'58': '95253', '86': '95251'}},
  agesYoung: {table: 9514, variable: '93', varyingClass: '287', categories: ['100362', ...CENSUS_YOUNG_AGES],
    fixedClasses: {'2': '6794', '286': '113635'}},
  agesOlder: {table: 9514, variable: '93', varyingClass: '287', categories: CENSUS_OLDER_AGES,
    fixedClasses: {'2': '6794', '286': '113635'}}
};

function censusRequestURL(spec) {
  const classes = `${spec.varyingClass}[${spec.categories.join(',')}]|` +
    Object.entries(spec.fixedClasses).map(([key, value]) => `${key}[${value}]`).join('|');
  return `https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/agregados/${spec.table}/periodos/${CENSUS_YEAR}` +
    `/variaveis/${spec.variable}?localidades=N6%5Ball%5D&classificacao=${encodeURIComponent(classes)}`;
}

function censusCount(value) {
  if (value === '-') return 0; // IBGE's conventional symbol for an actual zero.
  if (typeof value !== 'string' || !/^\d+$/.test(value)) return null;
  const numeric = Number(value);
  return Number.isSafeInteger(numeric) && numeric >= 0 ? numeric : null;
}

function parseCensusCounts(payload, spec) {
  if (!Array.isArray(payload) || payload.length !== 1 ||
      String(payload[0]?.id) !== spec.variable || payload[0]?.unidade !== 'Pessoas' ||
      !Array.isArray(payload[0]?.resultados)) throw new Error('Incompatible Census 2022 variable or unit.');
  const categories = new Map();
  for (const result of payload[0].resultados) {
    const actual = {};
    for (const classification of result.classificacoes || []) {
      const selected = Object.keys(classification.categoria || {});
      if (selected.length !== 1 || actual[String(classification.id)] !== undefined)
        throw new Error('Ambiguous Census 2022 classification.');
      actual[String(classification.id)] = selected[0];
    }
    const category = actual[spec.varyingClass];
    const expected = {...spec.fixedClasses, [spec.varyingClass]: category};
    if (!spec.categories.includes(category) ||
        JSON.stringify(Object.entries(actual).sort()) !== JSON.stringify(Object.entries(expected).sort()) ||
        categories.has(category) || !Array.isArray(result.series))
      throw new Error('Incompatible Census 2022 population selection.');
    const values = new Map();
    for (const item of result.series) {
      const code = String(item.localidade?.id || '');
      if (!/^\d{7}$/.test(code) || item.localidade?.nivel?.id !== 'N6' || values.has(code))
        throw new Error('Invalid or duplicated Census 2022 municipality.');
      if (Object.keys(item.serie || {}).length !== 1 || !Object.hasOwn(item.serie, String(CENSUS_YEAR)))
        throw new Error('Census 2022 response changed its reference year.');
      values.set(code, censusCount(item.serie[String(CENSUS_YEAR)]));
    }
    if (values.size !== CENSUS_EXPECTED_MUNICIPALITIES)
      throw new Error('Incomplete Census 2022 municipality universe.');
    categories.set(category, values);
  }
  if (categories.size !== spec.categories.length) throw new Error('Missing Census 2022 categories.');
  return categories;
}

function censusContentVersion(values, tables) {
  // Deterministic revision identifier: it changes when the returned counts change.
  let hash = 2166136261;
  const text = `${CENSUS_YEAR}|${tables}|` + Object.keys(values).sort().map(code => `${code}:${values[code]}`).join('|');
  for (const char of text) hash = Math.imul(hash ^ char.charCodeAt(0), 16777619) >>> 0;
  return `IBGE-Census-${CENSUS_YEAR}-${tables}-${hash.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')}`;
}

async function loadCensusLayers(fetchJson, options = {}) {
  if (typeof fetchJson !== 'function') throw new Error('Census API JSON fetcher is required.');
  const entries = await Promise.all(Object.entries(CENSUS_REQUESTS).map(async ([key, spec]) =>
    [key, parseCensusCounts(await fetchJson(censusRequestURL(spec)), spec)]));
  const raw = Object.fromEntries(entries);
  const baseCodes = [...raw.agesYoung.get('100362').keys()];
  const geometryCodes = new Set(options.geometryCodes || baseCodes);
  if (geometryCodes.size !== CENSUS_EXPECTED_MUNICIPALITIES ||
      [...geometryCodes].some(code => !/^\d{7}$/.test(code))) throw new Error('Incompatible Census 2022 geometry.');
  const coverageRatio = options.minCoverageRatio ?? 1;
  if (coverageRatio < .95 || coverageRatio > 1) throw new Error('Invalid Census coverage threshold.');
  const minimum = Math.ceil(geometryCodes.size * coverageRatio);
  const result = {};
  const fetchedAt = new Date().toISOString();

  function makeLayer(key, pairs, unit, tables) {
    const values = {}; let invalid = 0, excluded = 0, totalReported = 0;
    for (const [code, [numerator, denominator]] of pairs) {
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(numerator) || !Number.isSafeInteger(denominator) || numerator < 0 || denominator <= 0 ||
          (['water', 'sewer', 'waste', 'older65'].includes(key) && numerator > denominator)) {invalid++; continue;}
      const value = 100 * numerator / denominator;
      if (!Number.isFinite(value)) {invalid++; continue;}
      totalReported++;
      if (geometryCodes.has(code)) values[code] = value; else excluded++;
    }
    const available = Object.keys(values).length;
    if (available < minimum) throw new Error(`Incomplete valid Census 2022 ${key} coverage.`);
    result[key] = {values: Object.freeze(values), year: CENSUS_YEAR, valueUnit: unit,
      sourceVersion: censusContentVersion(values, tables), fetchedAt,
      coverage: {available, geometry: geometryCodes.size, totalReported, excluded,
        missing: geometryCodes.size - available, invalid},
      apiSources: Object.values(CENSUS_REQUESTS).filter(s => tables.includes(String(s.table))).map(censusRequestURL)};
  }
  for (const [key, denominatorCategory, numeratorCategory] of
      [['water', '72129', '72144'], ['sewer', '46292', '46290'], ['waste', '10972', '2520']]) {
    const data = raw[key], denominator = data.get(denominatorCategory), numerator = data.get(numeratorCategory);
    makeLayer(key, baseCodes.map(code => [code, [numerator.get(code), denominator.get(code)]]), '%', String(CENSUS_REQUESTS[key].table));
  }
  const total = raw.agesYoung.get('100362');
  function ageSum(data, ageCodes, code) {
    const counts = ageCodes.map(age => data.get(age)?.get(code));
    return counts.every(Number.isSafeInteger) ? counts.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) : null;
  }
  const demographicPairs = {older65: [], ageing: [], dependency: []};
  for (const code of baseCodes) {
    const all = total.get(code), young = ageSum(raw.agesYoung, CENSUS_YOUNG_AGES, code),
      older = ageSum(raw.agesOlder, CENSUS_OLDER_AGES, code);
    const valid = [all, young, older].every(Number.isSafeInteger) && all >= young + older;
    demographicPairs.older65.push([code, valid ? [older, all] : [null, null]]);
    demographicPairs.ageing.push([code, valid ? [older, young] : [null, null]]);
    demographicPairs.dependency.push([code, valid ? [young + older, all - young - older] : [null, null]]);
  }
  makeLayer('older65', demographicPairs.older65, '%', '9514');
  makeLayer('ageing', demographicPairs.ageing, 'people aged 65+ per 100 children aged 0–14', '9514');
  makeLayer('dependency', demographicPairs.dependency, 'people aged 0–14 or 65+ per 100 people aged 15–64', '9514');
  return result;
}

/* Official municipal Census 2022 requests. Invalid refreshes leave snapshots intact. */
function extraCensusAssert(condition, message) {
  if (!condition) throw new Error(`EXTRA_CENSUS_${message}`);
}

function extraCensusNumber(raw) {
  const text = String(raw ?? "").trim();
  if (text === "-") return 0; // Official SIDRA convention: exact numerical zero.
  if (text === "..." || text === ".." || /^x$/i.test(text)) return null;
  extraCensusAssert(/^[+-]?(?:\d+(?:[.,]\d*)?|[.,]\d+)$/.test(text), "INVALID_VALUE");
  const value = Number(text.replace(",", "."));
  extraCensusAssert(Number.isFinite(value), "NONFINITE_VALUE");
  return value;
}

function extraCensusUnit(unit) {
  const name = String(unit ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
  return ["%", "percentual", "porcentagem", "percentage", "percent"].includes(name) ? "%" : name;
}

function extraCensusSignature(classes) {
  return JSON.stringify(Object.entries(classes || {}).map(([key, value]) => [String(key), String(value)])
    .sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b)));
}

function extraCensusLabel(text) {
  return String(text).normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
    .toLowerCase().replace(/\s*\(codigo\)\s*$/, "").trim();
}

function extraCensusGeometryCodes(codes) {
  if (codes == null) return null;
  const values = codes instanceof Set || Array.isArray(codes) ? [...codes] : Object.keys(codes);
  const result = new Set(values.map(String));
  extraCensusAssert(result.size === values.length && result.size > 0, "INVALID_GEOMETRY_CODES");
  for (const code of result) extraCensusAssert(/^\d{7}$/.test(code), "INVALID_GEOMETRY_CODE");
  return result;
}

function extraCensusFinishValues(entries, request, geometry) {
  const values = {};
  for (const [rawCode, rawValue] of entries) {
    const code = String(rawCode);
    extraCensusAssert(/^\d{7}$/.test(code), "INVALID_MUNICIPAL_CODE");
    extraCensusAssert(!Object.hasOwn(values, code), "DUPLICATE_MUNICIPAL_CODE");
    extraCensusAssert(!geometry || geometry.has(code), "UNEXPECTED_MUNICIPAL_CODE");
    values[code] = extraCensusNumber(rawValue);
  }
  const codes = Object.keys(values).sort();
  extraCensusAssert(Number.isInteger(request.expectedTerritories) && request.expectedTerritories > 0,
    "INVALID_EXPECTED_TERRITORIES");
  extraCensusAssert(codes.length === request.expectedTerritories, "TERRITORY_COUNT_MISMATCH");
  if (geometry && request.expectedTerritories === geometry.size) {
    extraCensusAssert(codes.every(code => geometry.has(code)), "GEOGRAPHY_COVERAGE_MISMATCH");
  }
  return Object.fromEntries(codes.map(code => [code, values[code]]));
}

function parseExtraCensusV3(payload, request, geometry) {
  extraCensusAssert(Array.isArray(payload), "INVALID_V3_RESPONSE");
  const variables = payload.filter(variable => String(variable?.id) === String(request.variable));
  extraCensusAssert(variables.length === 1, "V3_VARIABLE_MISMATCH");
  const variable = variables[0];
  extraCensusAssert(extraCensusUnit(variable.unidade) === extraCensusUnit(request.unit), "V3_UNIT_MISMATCH");
  extraCensusAssert(Array.isArray(variable.resultados), "INVALID_V3_RESULTS");
  const results = variable.resultados.filter(result => {
    if (!Array.isArray(result.classificacoes)) return false;
    const classes = {};
    for (const classification of result.classificacoes) {
      const categories = Object.keys(classification.categoria || {});
      if (categories.length !== 1 || Object.hasOwn(classes, String(classification.id))) return false;
      classes[String(classification.id)] = categories[0];
    }
    return extraCensusSignature(classes) === extraCensusSignature(request.classes);
  });
  extraCensusAssert(results.length === 1 && Array.isArray(results[0].series), "V3_CLASSIFICATION_MISMATCH");
  const year = String(request.year ?? 2022);
  const entries = results[0].series.map(row => {
    extraCensusAssert(row?.localidade?.nivel?.id === "N6", "V3_TERRITORIAL_LEVEL_MISMATCH");
    extraCensusAssert(row.serie && Object.keys(row.serie).length === 1 && Object.hasOwn(row.serie, year),
      "V3_YEAR_MISMATCH");
    return [row.localidade.id, row.serie[year]];
  });
  return extraCensusFinishValues(entries, request, geometry);
}

function parseExtraCensusSidraV1(payload, request, geometry) {
  extraCensusAssert(Array.isArray(payload) && payload.length > 1, "INVALID_V1_RESPONSE");
  const header = payload[0];
  extraCensusAssert(header && typeof header === "object", "INVALID_V1_HEADER");
  const dimensions = Object.keys(header).filter(key => /^D\d+C$/.test(key));
  const field = name => dimensions.filter(key => extraCensusLabel(header[key]) === name);
  const municipality = field("municipio"), variable = field("variavel");
  const yearFields = [...field("ano"), ...field("periodo")];
  extraCensusAssert(municipality.length === 1 && variable.length === 1 && yearFields.length === 1,
    "V1_DIMENSION_HEADER_MISMATCH");
  const excluded = new Set([...municipality, ...variable, ...yearFields]);
  const classFields = dimensions.filter(key => !excluded.has(key));
  const expectedClasses = Object.entries(request.classes || {});
  extraCensusAssert(request.classNames && classFields.length === expectedClasses.length &&
    extraCensusSignature(Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(request.classNames).map(key => [key, "present"]))) ===
      extraCensusSignature(Object.fromEntries(expectedClasses.map(([key]) => [key, "present"]))),
    "V1_CLASS_NAMES_REQUIRED");
  const selectedFields = new Map();
  for (const [id, category] of expectedClasses) {
    const matches = classFields.filter(key => extraCensusLabel(header[key]) === extraCensusLabel(request.classNames[id]));
    extraCensusAssert(matches.length === 1 && ![...selectedFields.values()].some(value => value.key === matches[0]),
      "V1_CLASSIFICATION_HEADER_MISMATCH");
    selectedFields.set(id, {key: matches[0], category: String(category)});
  }
  const rows = payload.slice(1).filter(row => String(row[variable[0]]) === String(request.variable) &&
    [...selectedFields.values()].every(({key, category}) => String(row[key]) === category));
  extraCensusAssert(rows.length > 0, "V1_CLASSIFICATION_MISMATCH");
  const year = String(request.year ?? 2022);
  const entries = rows.map(row => {
    extraCensusAssert(String(row.NC) === "6", "V1_TERRITORIAL_LEVEL_MISMATCH");
    extraCensusAssert(extraCensusUnit(row.MN) === extraCensusUnit(request.unit), "V1_UNIT_MISMATCH");
    extraCensusAssert(String(row[yearFields[0]]) === year, "V1_YEAR_MISMATCH");
    return [row[municipality[0]], row.V];
  });
  return extraCensusFinishValues(entries, request, geometry);
}

function extraCensusExpressionInputs(expression) {
  if (typeof expression === "string") return [expression];
  extraCensusAssert(expression && typeof expression === "object" && !Array.isArray(expression), "INVALID_EXPRESSION");
  const keys = Object.keys(expression);
  extraCensusAssert(keys.length === 1 && ["sum", "subtract"].includes(keys[0]), "INVALID_EXPRESSION_OPERATION");
  const terms = expression[keys[0]];
  extraCensusAssert(Array.isArray(terms) && terms.length > 0 && (keys[0] !== "subtract" || terms.length === 2),
    "INVALID_EXPRESSION_TERMS");
  return terms.flatMap(extraCensusExpressionInputs);
}

function extraCensusEvaluate(expression, code, sources) {
  if (typeof expression === "string") return sources[expression].values[code];
  const operation = Object.keys(expression)[0];
  const values = expression[operation].map(term => extraCensusEvaluate(term, code, sources));
  if (values.some(value => value === null)) return null;
  return operation === "sum" ? values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) : values[0] - values[1];
}

function extraCensusRecipe(recipe) {
  extraCensusAssert(recipe && typeof recipe === "object" && Array.isArray(recipe.inputs), "INVALID_RECIPE");
  const operations = ["identity", "complement100", "ratio100", "ratio100Subtract", "sum", "log"];
  extraCensusAssert(operations.includes(recipe.op), "UNKNOWN_RECIPE_OPERATION");
  extraCensusAssert(recipe.inputs.length > 0, "EMPTY_RECIPE_INPUTS");
  let numerator = recipe.numerator ?? recipe.inputs[0];
  let denominator = recipe.denominator ?? recipe.inputs[1];
  if (recipe.op === "sum") numerator = {sum: recipe.inputs};
  if (recipe.op === "ratio100Subtract") {
    extraCensusAssert(recipe.inputs.length === 3, "RATIO_SUBTRACT_INPUT_COUNT");
    denominator = {subtract: [recipe.inputs[1], recipe.inputs[2]]};
  }
  const dependencies = extraCensusExpressionInputs(numerator);
  if (recipe.op === "ratio100" || recipe.op === "ratio100Subtract") {
    dependencies.push(...extraCensusExpressionInputs(denominator));
  }
  return {numerator, denominator, dependencies: [...new Set(dependencies)]};
}

function extraCensusVersion(text) {
  // Content version, not a cryptographic/security signature.
  let hash = 2166136261;
  for (let index = 0; index < text.length; index++) hash = Math.imul(hash ^ text.charCodeAt(index), 16777619);
  return (hash >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

/**
 * requests[id] = {url, variable, unit, classes, expectedTerritories, format,
 *   classNames?}; classNames is required for SIDRA-v1 response headers.
 * recipes[key] = {op, inputs:[requestId...], scopeExpected, unit?, numerator?,
 *   denominator?:{sum:[requestId...]|subtract:[totalRequest, under5Request]}}.
 * Only referenced requests are fetched, with identical URLs fetched once.
 * Layers retain only source territories. Outside-scope municipalities are never
 * invented as zero. log values retain their original counts in rawValues.
 */
async function loadExtraCensusLayers(fetchJson, requests, recipes, options = {}) {
  extraCensusAssert(typeof fetchJson === "function", "INVALID_FETCH_CALLBACK");
  extraCensusAssert(requests && recipes && typeof requests === "object" && typeof recipes === "object",
    "INVALID_CONFIGURATION");
  const geometry = extraCensusGeometryCodes(options.geometryCodes);
  const prepared = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(recipes).map(([key, recipe]) => [key, extraCensusRecipe(recipe)]));
  const requestIds = [...new Set(Object.values(prepared).flatMap(recipe => recipe.dependencies))];
  const fetches = new Map();
  for (const id of requestIds) {
    const request = requests[id];
    extraCensusAssert(request && typeof request.url === "string" && request.url.startsWith("https://"), "INVALID_REQUEST");
    extraCensusAssert(String(request.year ?? 2022) === "2022", "NON_CENSUS_YEAR");
    extraCensusAssert(["ibge-v3", "sidra-v1"].includes(request.format), "INVALID_RESPONSE_FORMAT");
    const url = new URL(request.url);
    extraCensusAssert(["servicodados.ibge.gov.br", "apisidra.ibge.gov.br"].includes(url.hostname), "UNOFFICIAL_API_HOST");
    if (!fetches.has(request.url)) fetches.set(request.url, Promise.resolve().then(() => fetchJson(request.url)));
  }
  const sources = {};
  await Promise.all(requestIds.map(async id => {
    const request = requests[id];
    const payload = await fetches.get(request.url);
    const values = request.format === "ibge-v3" ? parseExtraCensusV3(payload, request, geometry) :
      parseExtraCensusSidraV1(payload, request, geometry);
    sources[id] = {values, version: extraCensusVersion(JSON.stringify({request, values}))};
  }));
  const layers = {};
  for (const [key, recipe] of Object.entries(recipes)) {
    const plan = prepared[key];
    const first = sources[plan.dependencies[0]].values;
    const codes = Object.keys(first);
    extraCensusAssert(Number.isInteger(recipe.scopeExpected) && codes.length === recipe.scopeExpected,
      "RECIPE_TERRITORY_COUNT_MISMATCH");
    for (const id of plan.dependencies) {
      const source = sources[id].values;
      extraCensusAssert(Object.keys(source).length === codes.length && codes.every(code => Object.hasOwn(source, code)),
        "INPUT_GEOGRAPHIES_MISMATCH");
    }
    const values = {}, rawValues = {};
    for (const code of codes) {
      const numerator = extraCensusEvaluate(plan.numerator, code, sources);
      let value = numerator;
      if (recipe.op === "log") {
        rawValues[code] = numerator;
        extraCensusAssert(numerator === null || numerator >= 0, "NEGATIVE_LOG_INPUT");
        value = numerator === null || numerator === 0 ? null : Math.log(numerator);
      } else if (recipe.op === "complement100") {
        extraCensusAssert(numerator === null || (numerator >= 0 && numerator <= 100), "INVALID_COMPLEMENT_RATE");
        // Published literacy rates have two decimal places; preserve that precision.
        value = numerator === null ? null : Math.round((100 - numerator) * 1e10) / 1e10;
      } else if (recipe.op === "ratio100" || recipe.op === "ratio100Subtract") {
        const denominator = extraCensusEvaluate(plan.denominator, code, sources);
        extraCensusAssert(denominator === null || denominator >= 0, "NEGATIVE_DENOMINATOR");
        value = numerator === null || denominator === null || denominator === 0 ? null : numerator / denominator * 100;
      }
      extraCensusAssert(value === null || Number.isFinite(value), "NONFINITE_DERIVED_VALUE");
      values[code] = value;
    }
    const counted = recipe.op === "log" ? rawValues : values;
    const unit = recipe.unit || (recipe.op === "complement100" || recipe.op.startsWith("ratio100") ? "%" :
      recipe.op === "log" ? `ln(${requests[plan.dependencies[0]].unit})` : requests[plan.dependencies[0]].unit);
    layers[key] = {
      key, values, year: 2022, unit,
      sourceVersion: options.sourceVersion || `IBGE-Census2022:${extraCensusVersion(JSON.stringify({recipe,
        sources: plan.dependencies.map(id => [id, sources[id].version])}))}`,
      sourceTerritoryCount: codes.length,
      nonNullCount: Object.values(values).filter(value => value !== null).length,
      zeroCount: Object.values(counted).filter(value => value === 0).length,
      missingCodes: codes.filter(code => values[code] === null),
      ...(recipe.op === "log" ? {rawValues} : {}),
    };
  }
  return layers;
}

    desc.textContent=`All municipalities with data have the same value: ${municipalValue(field,domain.median)}.`;

function bootMunicipalMaps() {
  const views=new Map(),requested=new Set();let resources=null,uf="BR",selected=null,pinned=null,lastLibraryAttempt=0;
  try {const saved=sessionStorage.getItem("macro-municipal-uf-v1");if(validMunicipalUF(saved))uf=saved;} catch(_) {}
  const names=MUNICIPAL_SEED_ROWS,codes=new Set(Object.keys(names));
  const controller=createMunicipalDataController({cycleFor:monthlyUpdateCycle,monthLimitFor:observationMonthLimit,seedRows:names,seedVersions:MUNICIPAL_SEED_VERSIONS,geometryCodes:codes,onUpdate:layers=>{
    for(const field of MUNICIPAL_MAPS){const view=views.get(field.id);if(!view)continue;const previous=view.layer;view.layer=layers[field.key];updateLabels(view);if(previous?.values!==view.layer.values||previous?.year!==view.layer.year){view.dirty=true;draw(view);}}
  }});
  const initial=controller.snapshot();
  function updateLabels(view) {
    const {field,layer,root}=view;
    root.querySelector(".macro-plot-subtitle").textContent=municipalSubtitle(field,layer.year);
    root.querySelectorAll("[data-map-year]").forEach(el=>{el.textContent=String(layer.year);});
    const text=view.loadError ? "The map could not load. A retry will run automatically; the last valid data remain available." : municipalLayerStatus(layer),status=root.querySelector(".macro-status");status.textContent=text;status.hidden=!text;
    const coverage=layer.coverage,latest=root.querySelector("[data-map-latest]");
    latest.textContent=`Reference: ${field.periodLabel ? field.periodLabel+" " : field.key.startsWith("pbf")?"December ":""}${layer.year}. ${municipalNumber(coverage.available,0)} of ${municipalNumber(coverage.geometry,0)} reference territories have data.${coverage.excluded?" "+municipalNumber(coverage.excluded,0)+" additional source territories fall outside the 2022 boundaries.":""} ${layer.checkedAt?"API last checked "+layer.checkedAt.slice(0,10)+".":"Embedded snapshot verified "+(view.field.snapshotDate || MUNICIPAL_SNAPSHOT_DATE)+"."}`;
  }
  function showSelection(code,announce=false) {
    selected=validMunicipalCode(code)&& (uf==="BR"||names[code][1]===uf)?code:null;
    for(const view of views.values()) {
      const row=selected?names[selected]:null,path=view.geometry?.paths.find(item=>item.code===selected)?.path||"";
      view.chart.querySelector("[data-map-selection]")?.setAttribute("d",path);
      const value=row?view.layer.values[selected]:null;
      const detail=row?`${row[0]}, ${row[1]} · ${municipalValue(view.field,value,view.layer.rawValues?.[selected])}${view.field.key.startsWith("pbf")?" "+view.layer.year:" ("+view.layer.year+")"}`:"Hover or tap a municipality to see its value.";
      view.root.querySelector("[data-map-detail]").textContent=detail;
      if(announce)view.root.querySelector("[data-map-announcement]").textContent=detail;
    }
  }
  function draw(view) {
    if(view.root.closest("details.macro-section-group")?.open===false)return;
    const width=view.chart.clientWidth;if(width<120)return;
    const mobile=window.matchMedia("(max-width:600px)").matches,key=`${width}:${mobile}:${uf}`;
    // Reserve the final figure height before loading its libraries, keeping
    // contents navigation stable when another map lies above the target.
    view.chart.style.height=`${municipalDimensions(width,mobile,false,(view.field.colourScale === "official-idhm" ? 5 : view.field.colourScale === "survey-fixed-pubugn" ? MUNICIPAL_SURVEY_CLASS_SETTINGS.upperBounds.length+1 : view.field.colourScale === "positive-tail-pubugn" ? MUNICIPAL_FOREIGN_CLASS_SETTINGS.upperBounds.length+1 : ["decile-pubugn","tail-aware-pubugn"].includes(view.field.colourScale))).height}px`;

    if(!view.dirty&&view.sizeKey===key)return;
    view.geometry=municipalGeometry(resources.libraries,resources.topology,names,uf,width,mobile,false,(view.field.colourScale === "official-idhm" ? 5 : view.field.colourScale === "survey-fixed-pubugn" ? MUNICIPAL_SURVEY_CLASS_SETTINGS.upperBounds.length+1 : view.field.colourScale === "positive-tail-pubugn" ? MUNICIPAL_FOREIGN_CLASS_SETTINGS.upperBounds.length+1 : ["decile-pubugn","tail-aware-pubugn"].includes(view.field.colourScale)));
    const figure=buildMunicipalSVG(document,view.field,view.layer,view.geometry,names,uf);
    view.chart.replaceChildren(figure.svg);view.chart.setAttribute("aria-busy","false");view.chart.style.height=`${view.geometry.dims.height}px`;
    view.root.querySelector("[data-map-coverage]").textContent=`${uf==="BR"?"Brazil":MUNICIPAL_UFS.find(item=>item[0]===uf)[1]+" ("+uf+")"} · ${municipalNumber(figure.available,0)} / ${municipalNumber(figure.total,0)} municipalities with data`;

    registerSectionRedraw(field,root,()=>draw(view));

MUNICIPAL_SURVEY_CLASS_SETTINGS.upperBounds.length+1 : field.colourScale === "positive-tail-pubugn" ? MUNICIPAL_FOREIGN_CLASS_SETTINGS.upperBounds.length+1 : ["decile-pubugn","tail-aware-pubugn"].includes(field.colourScale)));
        const {svg}=buildMunicipalSVG(document,field,exportLayer,geometry,names,exportUF,true);
        const markup=new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(svg),url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([markup],{type:"image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8"}));
        try{
          const image=new Image();await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{image.onload=resolve;image.onerror=reject;image.src=url;});
          const canvas=document.createElement("canvas");canvas.width=geometry.dims.width*2;canvas.height=geometry.dims.height*2;const context=canvas.getContext("2d");context.fillStyle="#fff";context.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);context.drawImage(image,0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
          const blob=await new Promise(resolve=>canvas.toBlob(resolve,"image/png"));if(!blob)throw new Error("PNG export unavailable.");
          const png=URL.createObjectURL(blob);try{const link=document.createElement("a");link.href=png;link.download=`${field.id}-${exportLayer.year}-${exportUF.toLowerCase()}.png`;document.body.append(link);link.click();link.remove();}finally{setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(png),30000);}
        }finally{URL.revokeObjectURL(url);}
      }catch(_){const status=root.querySelector(".macro-status");status.textContent="PNG export could not be completed. Please try again.";status.hidden=false;}finally{view.exporting=false;button.disabled=false;}
    });

  }
  void controller.hydrate();
  registerRefresh({id:"municipal-maps"},async()=>{if(!requested.size)return;void controller.refresh();if(!resources&&Date.now()-lastLibraryAttempt>=300000)void start(MUNICIPAL_MAPS.find(field=>requested.has(field.id)));});
  if(typeof IntersectionObserver==="undefined")MUNICIPAL_MAPS.forEach(field=>void start(field));

function boot() {
  configureChartHeights();
  installSectionNavigation();
  bootMunicipalMaps();
  const initialized = new Set();
  function start(plot) {
    if (initialized.has(plot.id)) return;
    initialized.add(plot.id);
    void initializePlot(plot);
  }
  if (typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") PLOTS.forEach(start);
  else {
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
      for (const entry of entries) if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        const plot = PLOTS.find(item => `panel-${item.id}` === entry.target.id);
        if (plot) start(plot);
        observer.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    }, { rootMargin: "650px 0px" });
    PLOTS.forEach(plot => observer.observe(document.getElementById(`panel-${plot.id}`)));
    start(PLOTS[0]);
  }
}
